definition: used before countable or singular nouns referring to people or things that have not already been mentioned
example: a man/horse/unit
definition_zh: 用于指代尚未提及的人或物时，置于可数名词或单数名词之前
example_zh: 一个人/一匹马/一个单位

definition: a little more or less than; a little before or after
example: It costs about $10.
definition_zh: 比……多一点或少一点；比……早一点或晚一点

definition: on the subject of somebody/something; in connection with somebody/something
example: a book about flowers
definition_zh: 关于某人/某事；与某人/某事有关

definition: at or to a higher place
example: Put it on the shelf above.
definition_zh: 在……处或更高处
example_zh: 把它放在上面的架子上。

definition: at or to a higher place or position than something/somebody
example: The water came above our knees.
definition_zh: 与某物/某人处于同等或更高的位置或地位
example_zh: 水已经淹到我们膝盖以上了。

definition: from one side to the other side
example: It's too wide. We can't swim across.
definition_zh: 从这一边到另一边

definition: from one side to the other side of something
example: He walked across the field.
definition_zh: 从某物的这一侧到另一侧

definition: the process of doing something in order to make something happen or to deal with a situation
example: The time has come for action if these beautiful animals are to survive.
definition_zh: 为了使某事发生或处理某种情况而采取行动的过程
example_zh: 如果要让这些美丽的动物得以生存，现在是采取行动的时候了。

definition: a thing that you do for interest or pleasure
example: leisure/outdoor/recreational activities
definition_zh: 出于兴趣或乐趣而做的一件事

definition: a person who performs on the stage, on television or in films, especially as a profession
example: Both lead actors (= the ones who play the main parts) are outstanding.
definition_zh: 在舞台、电视或电影中进行表演的人，尤其是以此为职业的人
example_zh: 两位主演（即饰演主要角色的演员）都表现得非常出色。

definition: a woman who performs on the stage, on television or in films, especially as a profession
example: The Oscar-winning actress has taken a break from acting.
definition_zh: 在舞台、电视或电影中表演的女性，尤其是以此为职业的女性
example_zh: 这位奥斯卡奖得主目前暂别演艺圈。

definition: to put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, amount, etc.
example: add something, Next add the flour.
definition_zh: 将某物与另一物结合起来，以增加其规模、数量、数量等。
example_zh: 加入一些东西，接着加入面粉。

definition: details of where somebody lives or works and where letters, etc. can be sent
example: What's your name and address?
definition_zh: 有关某人居住或工作地点的详细信息，以及信件等可寄往何处

definition: a fully grown person who is legally responsible for their actions
example: Children must be accompanied by an adult.
definition_zh: 一个对自身行为负有法律责任的成年人

definition: an opinion or a suggestion about what somebody should do in a particular situation
example: expert/practical/professional/medical advice
definition_zh: 关于某人在特定情况下应该怎么做的一种看法或建议
example_zh: 专家/实用/专业/医疗建议

definition: feeling fear; frightened because you think that you might be hurt or suffer
example: Don't be afraid.
definition_zh: 感到恐惧；因为担心自己可能会受到伤害或遭受痛苦而感到害怕

definition: later than something; following something in time
example: We'll leave after lunch.
definition_zh: 晚于某事；在时间上紧随某事之后

definition: the period of time from 12 o'clock in the middle of the day until about 6 o’clock in the evening
example: this/yesterday/tomorrow afternoon
definition_zh: 从中午12点到傍晚6点左右这段时间

definition: one more time; on another occasion
example: This must never happen again.
definition_zh: 再一次；在另一个场合
example_zh: 这种事绝不能再发生了。

definition: the number of years that a person has lived or a thing has existed
example: You're the same age as my brother.
definition_zh: 一个人活了多少年，或者某物存在了多少年

definition: used in expressions of time with the simple past tense to show how far in the past something happened
example: two weeks/months/years ago
definition_zh: 用于简单过去时的时间表达中，以表明某件事发生在多远的过去

definition: to have the same opinion as somebody; to say that you have the same opinion
example: When he said that, I had to agree.
definition_zh: 与某人持相同观点；表示自己与某人持相同观点
example_zh: 他这么一说，我不得不表示赞同。

definition: the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth and that we breathe
example: Let's go out for some fresh air.
definition_zh: 包围地球且供我们呼吸的气体混合物
example_zh: 咱们出去呼吸点新鲜空气吧。

definition: a place where planes land and take off and that has buildings for passengers to wait in
example: Gatwick Airport
definition_zh: 一个飞机起降的地方，那里有供乘客候机的建筑物

definition: the whole number of
example: All horses are animals, but not all animals are horses.
definition_zh: 的总数为
example_zh: 所有的马都是动物，但并非所有的动物都是马。

definition: the whole number or amount
example: All of the food has gone.
definition_zh: 整个数字或金额

definition: in addition; too
example: She's fluent in French and German. She also speaks a little Italian.
definition_zh: 此外；也
example_zh: 她精通法语和德语。她还会说一点意大利语。

definition: at all times; on every occasion
example: There's almost always somebody at home in the evenings.
definition_zh: 在任何时候；在任何场合

definition: very surprising, especially in a way that you like or admire
example: an amazing feat/story/experience
definition_zh: 非常令人惊讶，尤其是以一种你喜欢或钦佩的方式
example_zh: 一项了不起的壮举/故事/经历

definition: also; in addition to
example: bread and butter
definition_zh: 此外；除了……之外

definition: having strong feelings about something that you dislike very much or about an unfair situation
example: Her behaviour really made me angry.
definition_zh: 对某件非常讨厌的事情或某种不公平的情况产生强烈情绪
example_zh: 她的行为真的让我很生气。

definition: a creature that is not a bird, a fish, a reptile, an insect or a human
example: the animals and birds of South America
definition_zh: 既非鸟类、鱼类、爬行动物、昆虫，也非人类的生物

definition: one more; an extra thing or person
example: Would you like another drink?
definition_zh: 再多一个；多出来的一件事或一个人

definition: one more; an extra thing or person
example: Would you like another drink?
definition_zh: 再多一个；多出来的一件事或一个人

definition: something that you say, write or do to react to a question or situation
example: I rang the bell, but there was no answer.
definition_zh: 针对某个问题或情况，你所说、所写或所做的事情
example_zh: 我按了门铃，但没人应门。

definition: to say, write or do something as a reaction to a question or situation
example: I repeated the question, but she didn't answer.
definition_zh: 针对某个问题或情况，说、写或做某事作为回应
example_zh: 我又问了一遍，但她没有回答。

definition: used with uncountable or plural nouns in negative sentences and questions, after if or whether, and after some verbs such as prevent, ban, forbid, etc. to refer to an amount or a number of something, however large or small
example: I didn't eat any meat.
definition_zh: 用于不可数名词或复数名词的否定句和疑问句中，位于“if”或“whether”之后，以及某些动词（如“prevent”、“ban”、“forbid”等）之后，以指代某事物的数量或数目，无论多少

definition: used in negative sentences and in questions and after if or whether to refer to an amount or a number, however large or small
example: We need some more paint; there isn't any left.
definition_zh: 用于否定句和疑问句中，以及在“if”或“whether”之后，用来指代一个数量或数字，无论其大小如何
example_zh: 我们还需要一些油漆；已经用完了。

definition: used instead of someone in negative sentences and in questions after if/whether, and after verbs such as prevent, forbid, avoid, etc.
example: Is anyone there?
definition_zh: 在否定句中、在“if”或“whether”之后的疑问句中，以及在“prevent”、“forbid”、“avoid”等动词之后，用它来代替“someone”。

definition: used instead of something in negative sentences and in questions; after if/whether; and after verbs such as prevent, ban, avoid, etc.
example: Would you like anything else?
definition_zh: 用于否定句和疑问句中代替某物；位于“if”或“whether”之后；以及位于“prevent”、“ban”、“avoid”等动词之后。

definition: a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a building
example: an apartment building
definition_zh: 一套用于居住的房间，通常位于建筑物的同一层

definition: a round fruit with shiny red or green skin that is fairly hard and white inside
example: Peel and core the apples.
definition_zh: 一种圆形水果，表皮呈鲜红或鲜绿色且有光泽，质地较硬，内部为白色

definition: the fourth month of the year, between March and May
example: in April, She was born in April.
definition_zh: 一年中的第四个月，介于三月和五月之间

definition: part of a place, town, etc., or a region of a country or the world
example: to improve access to services in rural areas
definition_zh: 某地、城镇等的一部分，或一个国家或世界上的某个地区
example_zh: 以改善农村地区的服务可及性

definition: either of the two long parts that stick out from the top of the body and connect the shoulders to the hands
example: He escaped with only a broken arm.
definition_zh: 从躯干顶部伸出、将肩膀与手连接起来的两个长部中的任意一个
example_zh: 他只受了点轻伤，胳膊骨折，便逃了出来。

definition: approximately
example: He arrived around five o'clock.
definition_zh: 大约

definition: surrounding somebody/something; on each side of something
example: The house is built around a central courtyard.
definition_zh: 围绕某人/某物；位于某物的两侧
example_zh: 这栋房子是以一个中央庭院为轴心建造的。

definition: to get to a place, especially at the end of a journey
example: I'll wait until they arrive.
definition_zh: 到达某地，尤其是旅程的终点

definition: the use of the imagination to express ideas or feelings, particularly in painting, drawing or sculpture
example: modern/contemporary art
definition_zh: 运用想象力来表达思想或情感，特别是在绘画、素描或雕塑中

definition: a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine, on a website, etc.
example: to read/write/publish an article
definition_zh: 刊登在报纸、杂志或网站等上的、关于特定主题的文章。

definition: a person who creates works of art, especially paintings or drawings
example: an exhibition of work by contemporary British artists
definition_zh: 创作艺术作品的人，尤其是绘画或素描作品
example_zh: 一场当代英国艺术家作品展

definition: used to describe somebody/something appearing to be somebody/something else
example: They were all dressed as clowns.
definition_zh: 用于描述某人或某物看似是另一个人或另一件事物
example_zh: 他们全都打扮成了小丑。

definition: to say or write something in the form of a question, in order to get information
example: How old are you—if you don’t mind me/my asking?
definition_zh: 以提问的形式说或写某事，以便获取信息
example_zh: 你多大了——如果你不介意我问的话？

definition: used to say where something/somebody is or where something happens
example: at the corner of the street
definition_zh: 用于表示某物/某人的位置或某事发生的地方

definition: the 8th month of the year, between July and September
example: She was born in August.
definition_zh: 该年的第8个月，介于7月和9月之间

definition: the sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle or aunt
example: Aunt Alice
definition_zh: 你父亲或母亲的姐妹；你叔叔或阿姨的妻子

definition: the season of the year between summer and winter, when leaves change colour and the weather becomes colder
example: in the autumn of something, in the autumn of 2010
definition_zh: 一年中介于夏季和冬季之间的季节，此时树叶变色，天气逐渐转冷

definition: to or at a distance from somebody/something in space or time
example: The beach is a mile away.
definition_zh: 在空间或时间上与某人/某物相距一定距离

definition: a very young child or animal
example: The baby's crying!
definition_zh: 一个非常年幼的孩子或动物

definition: to or into the place, condition, situation or activity where somebody/something was before
example: When is he coming back to work?
definition_zh: 回到或进入某人/某物之前所处的地方、状态、处境或活动

definition: the part of the human body that is on the opposite side to the chest, between the neck and the tops of the legs; the part of an animal’s body that corresponds to this
example: on your back, He was lying on his back on the sofa.
definition_zh: 人体中位于胸部对侧、颈部与大腿根部之间的部位；动物身体中与此相对应的部位
example_zh: 仰面躺着，他正仰面躺在沙发上。

definition: unpleasant; full of problems
example: I have some bad news for you, I'm afraid.
definition_zh: 令人不快；问题重重
example_zh: 恐怕我得告诉你一个坏消息。

definition: a container made of cloth, leather, plastic or paper, used to carry things in, especially when shopping or travelling
example: He was carrying a heavy bag of groceries.
definition_zh: 一种由布、皮革、塑料或纸制成的容器，用于装东西，尤其是在购物或旅行时
example_zh: 他手里提着一个沉甸甸的食品袋。

definition: a round object used for throwing, hitting or kicking in games and sports
example: a golf/tennis/bowling/soccer ball
definition_zh: 一种圆形物体，用于在游戏和体育运动中投掷、击打或踢击
example_zh: 高尔夫球/网球/保龄球/足球

definition: a long curved fruit with a thick yellow skin and that is soft inside, which grows on trees in hot countries
example: a bunch of bananas
definition_zh: 一种长而弯曲的果实，表皮厚且呈黄色，内部柔软，生长在热带国家的树上

definition: a small group of musicians who play popular music together, often with a singer or singers
example: a rock/punk/jazz band
definition_zh: 一个由几位音乐家组成的小型乐队，他们一起演奏流行音乐，通常配有一位或多位歌手
example_zh: 一支摇滚/朋克/爵士乐队

definition: an organization that provides various financial services, for example keeping or lending money
example: I don't have much money in the bank at the end of the month.
definition_zh: 一家提供各种金融服务的机构，例如存钱或放贷
example_zh: 每到月底，我银行里的钱就不多了。

definition: a large, long container that you put water in and then get into to wash your whole body
example: I'm in the bath!
definition_zh: 一个又大又长的容器，往里面倒水，然后钻进去洗全身

definition: a room in which there is a bath, a washbasin and often a toilet
example: Go and wash your hands in the bathroom.
definition_zh: 一个房间，里面设有浴缸、洗脸盆，通常还有马桶

definition: used when you are naming people or things, describing them or giving more information about them
example: + noun, Today is Monday.
definition_zh: 用于给人物或事物命名、描述它们或提供有关它们的更多信息

definition: used with a present participle to form progressive tenses
example: I am studying Chinese.
definition_zh: 与现在分词搭配使用，构成进行时

definition: an area of sand or small stones (called shingle), next to the sea or a lake
example: on the beach, tourists sunbathing on the beach
definition_zh: 紧邻大海或湖泊的一片沙地或碎石地（称为砾石滩）
example_zh: 在海滩上，游客们正在海滩上晒太阳

definition: having beauty; giving pleasure to the senses or to the mind
example: a beautiful woman/girl
definition_zh: 具有美感；能给感官或心灵带来愉悦

definition: for the reason that
example: I did it because he told me to.
definition_zh: 由于……
example_zh: 我这么做是因为他让我这么做的。

definition: to start to be something
example: + adj., It soon became apparent that no one was going to come.
definition_zh: 开始成为某种东西
example_zh: + 形容词，很快便显而易见，根本没人会来。

definition: a piece of furniture for sleeping on
example: a single/double bed
definition_zh: 一种用来睡觉的家具

definition: a room for sleeping in
example: the spare/guest bedroom
definition_zh: 一间用来睡觉的房间

definition: an alcoholic drink made from malt with hops added to give it taste. There are many types of beer.
example: a pint/can/bottle of beer
definition_zh: 一种用麦芽酿造、并添加啤酒花以增添风味的酒精饮料。啤酒的种类繁多。

definition: earlier than somebody/something
example: before lunch
definition_zh: 比某人/某事更早

definition: to start doing something; to do the first part of something
example: Shall I begin?
definition_zh: 开始做某事；做某事的第一步

definition: the time when something starts; the first part of an event, a story, etc.
example: A story has to have a beginning, middle, and end.
definition_zh: 某事开始的时候；事件、故事等的开头部分。
example_zh: 一个故事必须有开头、中间和结尾。

definition: at or towards the back of somebody/something; further back
example: She rode off down the road with the dog running behind.
definition_zh: 在某人/某物的后方或朝向后方；更靠后
example_zh: 她骑着马沿着路走了，那只狗在后面跑着。

definition: at or towards the back of somebody/something, and often hidden by it or them
example: Who's the girl standing behind Jan?
definition_zh: 位于某人或某物后方或朝向其后方，且通常被其遮挡
example_zh: 站在扬身后的那个女孩是谁？

definition: to feel certain that something is true or that somebody is telling you the truth
example: believe somebody, I don't believe you!
definition_zh: 确信某件事是真实的，或者某人正在对你说实话

definition: at or to a lower level, position or place
example: They live on the floor below.
definition_zh: 在同一水平、较低的水平、位置或场所

definition: at or to a lower level or position than somebody/something
example: He dived below the surface of the water.
definition_zh: 与某人/某物处于同等或更低的层次或职位

definition: of the most excellent type or quality
example: That's the best movie I've ever seen!
definition_zh: 最上乘的类型或品质
example_zh: 那是我看过的最棒的电影！

definition: of a higher standard or less poor quality; not as bad as something else
example: We're hoping for better weather tomorrow.
definition_zh: 标准更高或质量稍好；不像其他东西那么差
example_zh: 我们希望明天天气能好一点。

definition: in or into the space separating two or more points, objects, people, etc.
example: Q comes between P and R in the English alphabet.
definition_zh: 在两个或多个点、物体、人等之间的空间内或进入该空间。
example_zh: 在英语字母表中，Q位于P和R之间。

definition: a road vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing the pedals with your feet
example: He got on his bicycle and rode off.
definition_zh: 一种两轮的公路车辆，通过用脚蹬踏板来骑行
example_zh: 他骑上自行车，骑着离开了。

definition: large in size, degree, amount, etc.
example: a big man/house/increase
definition_zh: 在大小、程度、数量等方面很大。
example_zh: 一个大个子/一栋大房子/增加

definition: a bicycle
example: I used to ride my bike around the neighbourhood for hours.
definition_zh: 一辆自行车
example_zh: 我以前经常骑着自行车在附近转上好几个小时。

definition: a document that shows how much you owe somebody for goods or services
example: the phone/electricity/gas bill
definition_zh: 一份显示你因商品或服务而欠他人多少钱的文件

definition: a creature that is covered with feathers and has two wings and two legs. Most birds can fly.
example: a bird’s nest with two eggs in it
definition_zh: 一种全身长满羽毛、有两只翅膀和两条腿的生物。大多数鸟类都能飞。
example_zh: 一个鸟巢，里面有两枚蛋

definition: the day in each year which is the same date as the one on which you were born
example: Happy Birthday!
definition_zh: 每年中与你的出生日期相同的这一天

definition: having the very darkest colour, like coal or the sky at night
example: a shiny black car
definition_zh: 颜色极其深暗，如同煤炭或夜空一般
example_zh: 一辆闪闪发亮的黑色轿车

definition: the very darkest colour, like night or coal
example: the black of the night sky
definition_zh: 最深的颜色，像夜晚或煤炭一样

definition: a website where an individual person, or people representing an organization, write regularly about recent events or topics that interest them, usually with photos and links to other websites that they find interesting
example: This is a link to the museum's blog.
definition_zh: 一个网站，由个人或代表某组织的多人定期撰写关于近期事件或他们感兴趣的话题的文章，通常配有照片以及他们认为有趣的其他网站链接
example_zh: 这是该博物馆博客的链接。

definition: pale gold in colour
example: She had long blonde hair.
definition_zh: 呈浅金色

definition: having the colour of a clear sky or the sea on a clear day
example: piercing blue eyes
definition_zh: 呈现晴朗天空或晴朗日子里大海的颜色

definition: the colour of a clear sky or the sea on a clear day
example: bright/dark/light/pale/deep blue
definition_zh: 晴朗的日子里，晴空或大海的颜色
example_zh: 亮蓝/暗蓝/浅蓝/淡蓝/深蓝

definition: a vehicle (smaller than a ship) that travels on water, moved by oars, sails or a motor
example: a rowing/sailing boat
definition_zh: 一种在水面上行驶的交通工具（比船小），靠桨、帆或发动机驱动

definition: the whole physical structure of a human or an animal
example: The human body is a complex structure.
definition_zh: 人类或动物的整个身体结构
example_zh: 人体是一个复杂的结构。

definition: a set of printed pages that are fastened inside a cover so that you can turn them and read them
example: His desk was covered with piles of books.
definition_zh: 一组印好的页面，被装订在封面内，以便你可以翻动并阅读它们

definition: a strong shoe that covers the foot and ankle and often the lower part of the leg
example: (British English), walking boots
definition_zh: 一种结实的鞋子，能包裹住脚和脚踝，通常还能覆盖小腿下部

definition: feeling tired and impatient because you have lost interest in somebody/something or because you have nothing to do
example: There was a bored expression on her face.
definition_zh: 因为对某人或某事失去了兴趣，或者因为无事可做，而感到疲倦和不耐烦
example_zh: 她的脸上流露出一种无聊的神情。

definition: not interesting; making you feel tired and impatient
example: He's such a boring man!
definition_zh: 没意思；让人感到疲惫和不耐烦
example_zh: 他真是个无聊透顶的人！

definition: to come out of your mother’s body at the beginning of your life
example: I was born in 1976.
definition_zh: 在你生命伊始从母亲体内诞生

definition: used with plural nouns to mean ‘the two’ or ‘the one as well as the other’
example: Both women were French.
definition_zh: 与复数名词连用时，表示“这两个”或“这个和那个”
example_zh: 这两位女士都是法国人。

definition: used with plural nouns to mean ‘the two’ or ‘the one as well as the other’
example: Both women were French.
definition_zh: 与复数名词连用时，表示“这两个”或“这个和那个”
example_zh: 这两位女士都是法国人。

definition: a glass or plastic container, usually round with straight sides and a narrow neck, used especially for storing liquids
example: a wine/beer/milk/water bottle
definition_zh: 一种玻璃或塑料容器，通常呈圆形，侧壁笔直，瓶口狭窄，主要用于盛装液体
example_zh: 一瓶葡萄酒/啤酒/牛奶/水

definition: a container made of wood, thick card, metal, etc. with a flat stiff base and sides and often a lid (= cover), used especially for holding solid things
example: in a box, Everything we owned was neatly packed in cardboard boxes.
definition_zh: 一种由木材、厚纸板、金属等材料制成的容器，底部和侧壁平坦且坚硬，通常带有盖子（= 盖板），主要用于盛放固体物品
example_zh: 装在盒子里，我们所有的东西都整齐地装进了纸箱里。

definition: a male child or a young male person
example: a little/small/young boy
definition_zh: 男婴或年轻男子

definition: a man or boy that somebody has a romantic or sexual relationship with
example: She's got a new boyfriend.
definition_zh: 与某人存在恋爱或性关系的一名男子或男孩

definition: a type of food made from flour, water and usually yeast mixed together and baked
example: a loaf/slice/piece of bread
definition_zh: 一种由面粉、水和通常还加入酵母混合后烘烤而成的食物

definition: a short period of time when you stop what you are doing and rest, eat, etc.
example: She was on her lunch break.
definition_zh: 指暂停手头的工作，进行休息、进食等活动的短暂时间。

definition: to be damaged and separated into two or more parts, as a result of force; to damage something in this way
example: All the windows broke with the force of the blast.
definition_zh: 因外力作用而受损并分裂成两部分或更多部分；以这种方式损坏某物
example_zh: 爆炸的冲击波将所有的窗户都震碎了。

definition: the first meal of the day
example: They were having breakfast when I arrived.
definition_zh: 一天中的第一顿饭
example_zh: 我到的时候，他们正在吃早餐。

definition: to come to a place with somebody/something
example: bring somebody/something (with you), Don't forget to bring your books with you.
definition_zh: 与某人/某物一同来到某地
example_zh: 带上某人/某物，别忘了把书带上。

definition: a boy or man who has the same parents as another person
example: We're brothers.
definition_zh: 与另一个人父母相同的男孩或男子

definition: having the colour of earth or coffee
example: brown eyes/hair
definition_zh: 呈土色或咖啡色

definition: the colour of earth or coffee
example: leaves of various shades of brown
definition_zh: 泥土色或咖啡色
example_zh: 各种深浅不一的棕色树叶

definition: to make something, especially a building, by putting parts together
example: build (something), They have permission to build 200 new homes.
definition_zh: 通过将各个部分组合在一起，建造某物（尤其是建筑物）
example_zh: 建造（某物），他们获准建造200套新房。

definition: a structure such as a house or school that has a roof and walls
example: a tall/high-rise/ten-storey building
definition_zh: 指像房子或学校那样带有屋顶和墙壁的建筑物
example_zh: 一栋高楼/高层建筑/十层楼高的建筑

definition: a large road vehicle that carries passengers, especially one that travels along a fixed route and stops regularly to let people get on and off
example: by bus, Shall we walk or go by bus?
definition_zh: 一种用于载客的大型公路车辆，尤其是沿固定路线行驶并定期停靠以供乘客上下车的车辆
example_zh: 坐公交车，我们是走过去还是坐公交车去呢？

definition: the activity of making, buying, selling or supplying goods or services for money
example: It's been a pleasure to do business with you.
definition_zh: 为获取金钱而进行商品或服务的生产、购买、销售或供应的活动
example_zh: 能与您合作，我深感荣幸。

definition: having a lot to do; perhaps not free to do something else because you are working on something
example: Are you busy tonight?
definition_zh: 手头有很多事情要做；也许因为正在处理某件事，所以没空做别的事

definition: used to introduce a word or phrase that contrasts with what was said before
example: I got it wrong. It wasn't the red one but the blue one.
definition_zh: 用于引出一个与前文内容形成对比的词或短语
example_zh: 我搞错了。不是那个红色的，而是那个蓝色的。

definition: a soft yellow food made from cream, used in cooking and for spreading on bread
example: Fry the onions in butter.
definition_zh: 一种由奶油制成的柔滑黄色食品，既可用于烹饪，也可涂抹在面包上

definition: to obtain something by paying money for it
example: buy (something), Where did you buy that dress?
definition_zh: 通过付钱来获得某物
example_zh: 买（某物），你是在哪里买的这条裙子？

definition: used for showing how or in what way something is done
example: The house is heated by gas.
definition_zh: 用于说明某事是如何或以何种方式完成的
example_zh: 这栋房子使用天然气供暖。

definition: goodbye
example: Bye! See you next week.
definition_zh: 再见

definition: a place where you can buy drinks and simple meals. Alcohol is not usually served in British or American cafes.
example: There are small shops and pavement cafes around every corner.
definition_zh: 一个可以购买饮料和简餐的地方。英国或美国的咖啡馆通常不提供酒类饮品。
example_zh: 每个街角都有小商店和路边咖啡馆。

definition: a sweet food made from a mixture of flour, eggs, butter, sugar, etc. that is baked in an oven. Cakes are made in various shapes and sizes and are often decorated, for example with cream or icing.
example: a piece/slice of cake
definition_zh: 一种由面粉、鸡蛋、黄油、糖等混合制成，并在烤箱中烘烤而成的甜点。蛋糕的形状和大小多种多样，通常还会进行装饰，例如用奶油或糖霜装饰。

definition: the act of speaking to somebody on the phone
example: to get/receive a call from somebody
definition_zh: 通过电话与某人交谈的行为

definition: to give somebody/something a particular name; to use a particular name or title when you are talking to somebody
example: call somebody/something + noun, They decided to call the baby Mark.
definition_zh: 给某人/某物起一个特定的名字；在与某人交谈时使用特定的名字或称谓
example_zh: 给某人/某物起名叫……，他们决定给宝宝起名叫马克。

definition: a piece of equipment for taking photographs, moving pictures or television pictures. It can be a separate item or part of another device.
example: Just point the camera and press the button.
definition_zh: 一种用于拍摄照片、电影或电视画面的设备。它可以是独立的设备，也可以是另一台设备的一部分。
example_zh: 只需对准拍摄对象，按下快门即可。

definition: used to say that it is possible for somebody/something to do something, or for something to happen
example: I can run fast.
definition_zh: 用于表示某人或某物有可能做某事，或者某事有可能发生

definition: the negative of can; can not
example: I cannot believe the price of the tickets!
definition_zh: “can”的否定形式；不能
example_zh: 我简直不敢相信票价竟然这么贵！

definition: having the form and size used at the beginning of a sentence or a name
example: English is written with a capital ‘E’.
definition_zh: 指在句子开头或人名中使用的形式和大小

definition: the most important town or city of a country or region, where the government operates from
example: Cairo is the capital of Egypt.
definition_zh: 一个国家或地区最重要的城镇或城市，政府以此为据点开展工作

definition: a road vehicle with an engine and four wheels that can carry a small number of passengers
example: Paula got into the car and drove off.
definition_zh: 一种配备发动机和四个车轮、可搭载少量乘客的公路车辆
example_zh: 保拉上了车，开车离开了。

definition: thick, stiff paper; a piece of this for writing on
example: a piece of card
definition_zh: 厚而硬的纸；拿一张这样的纸来写字

definition: the series of jobs that a person has in a particular area of work, usually involving more responsibility as time passes
example: a teaching career
definition_zh: 一个人在特定工作领域内所担任的一系列职位，通常随着时间的推移，职责会逐渐加重

definition: a long pointed orange root vegetable
example: grated carrot
definition_zh: 一种细长尖头的橙色根茎类蔬菜

definition: to support the weight of somebody/something and take them or it from place to place; to take somebody/something from one place to another
example: carry somebody/something, He was carrying a large bag.
definition_zh: 支撑某人或某物的重量，并将他们或它从一处移至另一处；将某人或某物从一处带到另一处
example_zh: 携带某人/某物，他正扛着一个大包。

definition: a small animal with soft fur that people often keep as a pet. Cats catch and kill birds and mice.
example: a tin of cat food
definition_zh: 一种毛发柔软的小动物，人们常将其作为宠物饲养。猫会捕杀鸟类和老鼠。

definition: a small disc on which sound or information is recorded. CDs can be played or read on various types of machines, including CD players and computers. (the abbreviation for ‘compact disc’)
example: on CD, His albums are available on CD and online.
definition_zh: 一种用于记录声音或信息的小圆盘。CD可以在各种设备上播放或读取，包括CD播放器和计算机。（“compact disc”的缩写）
example_zh: CD版，他的专辑有CD版和在线版。

definition: a coin and unit of money worth 1% of the main unit of money in many countries, for example of the US dollar or of the euro
example: A one-minute phone call to the UK cost 10 cents.
definition_zh: 一种硬币及货币单位，其价值相当于许多国家主要货币单位的1%，例如美元或欧元
example_zh: 打一分钟电话到英国的费用是10美分。

definition: the middle point or part of something
example: He walked to the centre of the circle.
definition_zh: 某事物的中间点或部分

definition: a period of 100 years
example: A century ago, Valparaiso was the country's main port.
definition_zh: 100年的时间
example_zh: 一个世纪前，瓦尔帕莱索是该国的主要港口。

definition: a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back, a seat and four legs
example: a table and chairs
definition_zh: 一种供一人坐的家具，带有靠背、座面和四条腿

definition: the act or result of something becoming different
example: change in something, We're hoping for a change in the weather.
definition_zh: 某事物发生变化的过程或结果
example_zh: 某事发生变化，我们希望天气能有所变化。

definition: to become different
example: Rick hasn't changed. He looks exactly the same as he did at school.
definition_zh: 变得与众不同
example_zh: 里克一点也没变。他看起来和上学时一模一样。

definition: a diagram, lists of figures, etc. that shows information
example: Some shares have lost two-thirds of their value since being issued (see chart).
definition_zh: 图表、图例列表等，用于展示信息
example_zh: 有些股票自发行以来，市值已下跌了三分之二（见图表）。

definition: costing little money or less money than you expected
example: cheap imports/flights
definition_zh: 花不了多少钱，或者比你预期的要少

definition: to examine something to see if it is correct, safe or acceptable
example: check something, She gave me the minutes of the meeting to read and check.
definition_zh: 检查某事，以确定其是否正确、安全或可接受
example_zh: 核对一下，她把会议纪要交给我，让我阅读并核对。

definition: a type of food made from milk that can be either soft or hard and is usually white or yellow in colour; a particular type of this food
example: Cheddar cheese
definition_zh: 一种用牛奶制成的食品，质地可软可硬，通常呈白色或黄色；该食品的特定种类

definition: a large bird that is often kept for its eggs or meat
example: They keep chickens in the back yard.
definition_zh: 一种常因产蛋或肉用而被饲养的大型鸟类

definition: a young human who is not yet an adult
example: a child of 3/a 3-year-old child
definition_zh: 尚未成年的人类青少年

definition: a hard brown sweet food made from cocoa beans, used in cooking to add taste to cakes, etc. or eaten as a sweet
example: a chocolate bar
definition_zh: 一种由可可豆制成的坚硬棕色甜食，可用于烹饪以增添蛋糕等的风味，也可作为甜点直接食用。

definition: to decide which thing or person you want out of the ones that are available
example: You choose—I can't decide.
definition_zh: 从现有选项中决定你想要哪样东西或哪个人
example_zh: 你来选吧——我拿不定主意。

definition: a building in which films are shown
example: the local cinema
definition_zh: 一座放映电影的建筑

definition: a large and important town
example: Parking is difficult in the city centre.
definition_zh: 一座规模庞大且重要的城镇

definition: a group of students who are taught together
example: in the/your class, We were in the same class at school.
definition_zh: 一群一起上课的学生
example_zh: 在……的/你的班上，我们以前在学校是同班同学。

definition: a room where a class of children or students is taught
example: classroom activities
definition_zh: 一间用于给孩子们或学生上课的教室

definition: not dirty
example: Are your hands clean?
definition_zh: 不脏

definition: to remove the dirt or dust from something
example: I spent all day cooking and cleaning.
definition_zh: 清除某物上的污垢或灰尘
example_zh: 我一整天都在做饭和打扫卫生。

definition: to go up something towards the top
example: climb (up) something, to climb a mountain/tree
definition_zh: 沿着某物向上爬到顶部
example_zh: 攀爬（某物），指攀登山峰/树木

definition: an instrument for measuring and showing time, in a room, on the wall of a building or on a computer screen (not worn or carried like a watch)
example: The clock struck twelve/midnight.
definition_zh: 一种用于测量和显示时间的仪器，通常放置在房间内、建筑物的墙上或电脑屏幕上（不像手表那样佩戴或随身携带）
example_zh: 时钟敲响了十二点/午夜。

definition: to put something into a position so that it covers an opening; to get into this position
example: He closed the door firmly.
definition_zh: 将某物放置在某个位置，使其遮住开口；采取这种姿势
example_zh: 他“啪”地一声把门关上了。

definition: the things that you wear, such as trousers, dresses and jackets
example: I bought some new clothes for the trip.
definition_zh: 你穿的衣服，比如裤子、连衣裙和夹克
example_zh: 我为这次旅行买了一些新衣服。

definition: an organization for people who share an interest or do a sport or activity together
example: a golf/tennis/chess/film club
definition_zh: 由兴趣相投或共同从事某项运动或活动的人组成的组织
example_zh: 高尔夫/网球/国际象棋/电影俱乐部

definition: a piece of outdoor clothing that is worn over other clothes to keep warm or dry. Coats have sleeves (= parts covering the arms) and may be long or short.
example: to wear a coat
definition_zh: 一种穿在其他衣服外面的户外服装，用于保暖或防潮。大衣有袖子（即覆盖手臂的部分），可长可短。

definition: the roasted seeds (called coffee beans) of a tropical bush; a powder made from them
example: ground/real/instant coffee
definition_zh: 一种热带灌木的烘焙种子（称为咖啡豆）；用其制成的粉末
example_zh: 研磨咖啡/速溶咖啡/即溶咖啡

definition: having a lower than usual temperature; having a temperature lower than the human body
example: I'm cold. Turn the heating up.
definition_zh: 温度低于正常水平；温度低于人体温度

definition: a common illness that affects the nose and/or throat, making you cough, sneeze, etc.
example: I've got a cold.
definition_zh: 一种常见的疾病，会影响鼻子和/或喉咙，导致咳嗽、打喷嚏等症状。

definition: (in the UK) a place where students go to study or to receive training after they have left school
example: a secretarial college
definition_zh: （在英国）学生从学校毕业后去学习或接受培训的地方

definition: the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light. Red, orange and green are colours.
example: What's your favourite colour?
definition_zh: 物体因反射光线的方式而呈现出的外观。红色、橙色和绿色都是颜色。
example_zh: 你最喜欢的颜色是什么？

definition: to move to or towards a person or place
example: + adv./prep., He left and said he was never coming back.
definition_zh: 向某人或某地移动
example_zh: + 副词/介词，他走了，并说他再也不会回来了。

definition: happening often; existing in large numbers or in many places
example: a common problem/occurrence/practice
definition_zh: 经常发生；数量众多或分布广泛
example_zh: 一个常见的问题/现象/做法

definition: a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services
example: insurance/oil/tech/technology/pharmaceutical companies
definition_zh: 一种通过生产或销售商品或服务来盈利的商业组织
example_zh: 保险/石油/科技/技术/制药公司

definition: to examine people or things to see how they are similar and how they are different
example: compare A and B, It is interesting to compare their situation and ours.
definition_zh: 对人和事物进行考察，以了解它们的相似之处和不同之处
example_zh: 比较A和B，将它们的情况与我们的情况进行对比，这很有意思。

definition: including all the parts, etc. that are necessary; whole
example: a complete list/sequence/picture/profile
definition_zh: 包括所有必要的部件等；整体
example_zh: 完整的列表/顺序/图片/简介

definition: to finish making or doing something
example: to complete a course/project
definition_zh: 完成某件事
example_zh: 完成一门课程/一个项目

definition: an electronic machine that can store, organize and find information, do processes with numbers and other data, and control other machines
example: a home computer
definition_zh: 一种能够存储、整理和检索信息，对数字和其他数据进行处理，并控制其他机器的电子设备

definition: a public performance of music
example: to attend/go to a concert
definition_zh: 音乐公开演出

definition: an informal talk involving a small group of people or only two; the activity of talking in this way
example: a phone conversation
definition_zh: 指一小群人或仅两人之间进行的非正式交谈；这种交谈活动

definition: to prepare food by heating it, for example by boiling, baking or frying it
example: Where did you learn to cook?
definition_zh: 通过加热来烹饪食物，例如煮、烤或炸
example_zh: 你是在哪里学会做饭的？

definition: the process of preparing food by heating it
example: My husband does all the cooking.
definition_zh: 通过加热来制作食物的过程

definition: fairly cold; not hot or warm
example: cool air/water
definition_zh: 相当冷；既不热也不暖和

definition: accurate or true, without any mistakes
example: Do you have the correct time?
definition_zh: 准确或真实，没有任何错误

definition: to make something right or accurate, for example by changing it or removing mistakes
example: correct something, to correct an error
definition_zh: 使某事正确或准确，例如通过修改或纠正错误来实现

definition: the amount of money that you need in order to buy, make or do something
example: cost of something, the high/low cost of housing
definition_zh: 为了购买、制作或完成某件事所需的金额
example_zh: 某物的成本，住房成本的高低

definition: if something costs a particular amount of money, you need to pay that amount in order to buy, make or do it
example: cost something, How much did it cost?
definition_zh: 如果某样东西需要花费一定金额，你就必须支付这笔钱才能购买、制作或完成它

definition: used as the past tense of ‘can’
example: She said that she couldn't come.
definition_zh: 用作“can”的过去式

definition: an area of land that has or used to have its own government and laws
example: European countries
definition_zh: 指目前或曾经拥有自己的政府和法律的领土区域

definition: a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject
example: a French/chemistry course
definition_zh: 关于某个特定主题的一系列课程或讲座

definition: a child of your aunt or uncle
example: She's my cousin.
definition_zh: 你姑姑或叔叔的孩子

definition: a large animal kept on farms to produce milk or beef
example: to milk a cow
definition_zh: 一种在农场饲养、用于产奶或产肉的大型动物

definition: the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid that rises to the top of milk, used in cooking or as a type of sauce to put on fruit, etc.
example: We had strawberries and cream for dessert.
definition_zh: 浮在牛奶表面的浓稠白色或淡黄色脂肪液体，可用于烹饪，或作为一种酱汁淋在水果等食物上。
example_zh: 我们吃了草莓配奶油作为甜点。

definition: to make something happen or exist
example: Scientists disagree about how the universe was created.
definition_zh: 使某事发生或存在
example_zh: 科学家们对宇宙是如何形成的存在分歧。

definition: the customs and beliefs, art, way of life and social organization of a particular country or group
example: African/American/European/Islamic culture
definition_zh: 某个国家或群体的习俗与信仰、艺术、生活方式和社会组织形式
example_zh: 非洲/美洲/欧洲/伊斯兰文化

definition: a small container that is like a bowl in shape, usually with a handle, used for drinking tea, coffee, etc.
example: He filled the cup with water.
definition_zh: 一种形状类似碗的小容器，通常带有把手，用于喝茶、喝咖啡等。

definition: a person or an organization that buys goods or services from a shop or business
example: marketing strategies to target potential customers
definition_zh: 从商店或企业购买商品或服务的人或组织
example_zh: 针对潜在客户的营销策略

definition: to make an opening or a wound in something, especially with a sharp tool such as a knife or scissors
example: cut something, She cut her finger on a piece of glass.
definition_zh: 在某物上切开一个口子或造成一道伤口，尤其是使用刀具或剪刀等锋利工具
example_zh: 割伤某物，她被一块玻璃割伤了手指。

definition: father
example: That's my dad over there.
definition_zh: 父亲

definition: a series of movements and steps that are usually performed to music; a particular example of these movements and steps
example: Do you know any other Latin American dances?
definition_zh: 通常伴随音乐进行的一系列动作和步伐；这些动作和步伐中的一个具体例子
example_zh: 你还知道其他拉丁美洲的舞蹈吗？

definition: to move your body to the sound and rhythm of music
example: Do you want to dance?
definition_zh: 随着音乐的旋律和节奏摆动身体

definition: a person who dances or whose job is dancing
example: She's a fantastic dancer.
definition_zh: 跳舞的人，或以跳舞为职业的人

definition: moving your body to music
example: There was music and dancing till two in the morning.
definition_zh: 随着音乐舞动身体
example_zh: 音乐和舞蹈一直持续到凌晨两点。

definition: likely to injure or harm somebody, or to damage or destroy something
example: The situation is extremely dangerous.
definition_zh: 可能导致他人受伤或受到伤害，或导致某物受损或被毁坏

definition: with no or very little light, especially because it is night
example: a dark room/street/forest/night
definition_zh: 没有光线或光线非常微弱，尤其是因为天黑了
example_zh: 一间昏暗的房间/街道/森林/夜晚

definition: a particular day of the month, sometimes in a particular year, given in numbers and words
example: ‘What's the date today?’ ‘The 10th.’
definition_zh: 某个月的某一天，有时指某一年中的某一天，用数字和文字表示

definition: a person’s female child
example: We have two sons and a daughter.
definition_zh: 某人的女儿
example_zh: 我们有两个儿子和一个女儿。

definition: a period of 24 hours
example: ‘What day is it today?’ ‘Monday.’
definition_zh: 24小时

definition: used at the beginning of a letter before the name or title of the person that you are writing to
example: Dear Sir or Madam
definition_zh: 用于信件开头，位于收信人姓名或头衔之前

definition: the 12th and last month of the year
example: She was born in December.
definition_zh: 一年中的第12个月，也是最后一个月

definition: to think carefully about the different possibilities that are available and choose one of them
example: It's up to you to decide.
definition_zh: 仔细考虑各种可选方案，并从中选择一种

definition: having a very pleasant taste or smell
example: Who cooked this? It's absolutely delicious.
definition_zh: 味道或气味非常宜人
example_zh: 这是谁做的？简直太好吃了。

definition: to say what somebody/something is like
example: describe somebody/something, The next section describes our findings in detail.
definition_zh: 用来描述某人或某物是什么样的
example_zh: 描述某人/某事，下一节将详细介绍我们的研究结果。

definition: a piece of writing or speech that says what somebody/something is like; the act of writing or saying in words what somebody/something is like
example: Follow the link below for a more detailed description.
definition_zh: 描述某人或某物特征的文字或讲话；用语言描述某人或某物特征的行为
example_zh: 请点击下方链接查看更详细的说明。

definition: the general arrangement of the different parts of something that is made, such as a building, book, machine, etc.
example: The basic design of the car is very similar to that of earlier models.
definition_zh: 某件成品（如建筑物、书籍、机器等）各部分的总体布局。
example_zh: 这款车的基本设计与早期车型非常相似。

definition: to decide how something will look, work, etc., by drawing plans, making computer models, etc.
example: design something, He designed and built his own house.
definition_zh: 通过绘制图纸、制作计算机模型等方式，确定某物的外观、功能等。
example_zh: 设计点什么，他亲自设计并建造了自己的房子。

definition: a piece of furniture like a table, often with drawers (= parts like boxes in it with handles on the front for pulling them open), that you sit at to read, write, work, etc.
example: at a desk, I spend all day sitting at a desk.
definition_zh: 一种像桌子一样的家具，通常带有抽屉（即内部像盒子一样的部件，前面有把手以便拉开），人们坐在桌前阅读、写作、工作等。
example_zh: 在办公桌前，我整天都坐在办公桌前。

definition: a small individual fact or item; a less important fact or item
example: an expedition planned down to the last detail
definition_zh: 一个微不足道的事实或事项；一个不太重要的事实或事项
example_zh: 一项规划得一丝不苟的探险活动

definition: a conversation in a book, play or film or in language teaching materials
example: Learners are asked to listen to three short dialogues.
definition_zh: 书籍、戏剧、电影或语言教学材料中的对话
example_zh: 请学习者收听三段简短的对话。

definition: a book or electronic resource that gives a list of the words of a language in alphabetical order and explains what they mean, or gives a word for them in a foreign language
example: a Spanish-English dictionary
definition_zh: 一本书或电子资源，其中按字母顺序列出了某种语言的词汇，并解释了这些词的含义，或者给出了这些词在另一种语言中的对应词
example_zh: 一本西班牙语-英语词典

definition: to stop living
example: My father died suddenly at the age of 48.
definition_zh: 停止生活
example_zh: 我父亲在48岁时突然去世了。

definition: the food and drink that you eat and drink regularly
example: to eat a healthy, balanced diet
definition_zh: 您平时常吃的食物和常喝的饮料

definition: the way in which two people or things are not like each other; the way in which somebody/something has changed
example: Americans and Brits speak the same language, but there are big cultural differences.
definition_zh: 两个人或两件事物之间不同的方面；某人或某物发生变化的情况
example_zh: 美国人和英国人讲同一种语言，但两国在文化上存在很大差异。

definition: not the same as somebody/something; not like somebody/something else
example: different from somebody/something, American English is significantly different from British English.
definition_zh: 与某人/某物不同；不像其他某人/某物
example_zh: 与某人/某物不同，美式英语与英式英语有显著差异。

definition: not easy; needing effort or skill to do or to understand
example: The competition judges were given a very difficult task.
definition_zh: 不容易；做起来或理解起来需要付出努力或具备技巧
example_zh: 比赛评委们面临着一项非常艰巨的任务。

definition: the main meal of the day, eaten either in the middle of the day or in the evening
example: It's time for dinner.
definition_zh: 一天中的主餐，通常在中午或晚上食用

definition: not clean
example: dirty hands/clothes/dishes
definition_zh: 不干净

definition: to talk about something with somebody, especially in order to decide something
example: discuss something with somebody, Have you discussed the problem with anyone?
definition_zh: 与某人讨论某事，尤其是为了做出决定
example_zh: 与某人讨论某事，你和谁讨论过这个问题吗？

definition: a flat shallow container for cooking food in or serving it from
example: a baking/serving dish
definition_zh: 一种用于烹饪或盛放食物的扁平浅口容器

definition: used to refer to actions that you do not mention by name or do not know about
example: What are you doing this evening?
definition_zh: 用于指代那些你未点名提及或不知情的行为

definition: used before a full verb to form negative sentences and questions
example: I don't like fish.
definition_zh: 用于完整动词之前，以构成否定句和疑问句

definition: a person who has been trained in medical science, whose job is to treat people who are ill or injured
example: You'd better see a doctor about that cough.
definition_zh: 受过医学培训的人，其工作是治疗患病或受伤的人
example_zh: 你最好去看医生，把这咳嗽治一治。

definition: an animal with four legs and a tail, often kept as a pet or trained for work, for example hunting or guarding buildings. There are many types of dog, some of which are wild.
example: I took the dog for a walk.
definition_zh: 一种有四条腿和一条尾巴的动物，常被当作宠物饲养，或经过训练用于工作，例如狩猎或看守建筑物。狗的种类繁多，其中有些是野生的。

definition: the unit of money in the US, Canada, Australia and several other countries
example: You will be paid in American dollars.
definition_zh: 美国、加拿大、澳大利亚及其他几个国家的货币单位
example_zh: 您的薪酬将以美元支付。

definition: a piece of wood, glass, etc. that is opened and closed so that people can get in and out of a room, building, car, etc.; a similar thing in a cupboard
example: Open the door!
definition_zh: 一块木头、玻璃等，可以开合，以便人们进出房间、建筑物、汽车等；橱柜中类似的部件

definition: to or at a lower place or position
example: She jumped down off the chair.
definition_zh: 到或位于较低的地方或位置

definition: from a high or higher point on something to a lower one
example: The stone rolled down the hill.
definition_zh: 从某物上的高处或更高处到低处
example_zh: 那块石头从山坡上滚了下来。

definition: down the stairs; on or to a floor of a house or building lower than the one you are on, especially the one at ground level
example: I couldn't sleep so I went downstairs and watched TV.
definition_zh: 下楼梯；前往比你所在楼层更低的楼层，尤其是位于一楼的楼层
example_zh: 我睡不着，就下楼看电视了。

definition: to make pictures, or a picture of something, with a pencil, pen or chalk (but not paint)
example: You draw beautifully.
definition_zh: 用铅笔、钢笔或粉笔（但不包括颜料）画画，或画某物的图画

definition: a piece of clothing that is made in one piece and hangs down to cover the body as far as the legs, sometimes reaching to below the knees, or to the ankles
example: a long white dress
definition_zh: 一种由整块布料制成的服装，垂坠而下，覆盖身体直至双腿，有时甚至下摆可及膝盖以下，或直达脚踝
example_zh: 一条长长的白色连衣裙

definition: to put clothes on yourself/somebody
example: I dressed quickly.
definition_zh: 给自己/别人穿衣服

definition: a liquid for drinking; an amount of a liquid that you drink
example: Can I have a drink?
definition_zh: 可饮用的液体；饮用的液体量

definition: to take liquid into your mouth and then down your throat into your stomach
example: drink something, I don't drink coffee.
definition_zh: 将液体送入口中，然后顺着喉咙流入胃中
example_zh: 喝点什么吧，我不喝咖啡。

definition: to operate a vehicle so that it goes in a particular direction
example: Can you drive?
definition_zh: 驾驶车辆使其朝特定方向行驶

definition: a person who drives a vehicle
example: a bus/train/taxi driver
definition_zh: 驾驶机动车的人
example_zh: 公交车/火车/出租车司机

definition: all through a period of time
example: during the 1990s
definition_zh: 在整个一段时间内

definition: a disk on which large amounts of information, especially films, photographs and video, can be stored, for use on a DVD player or computer (the abbreviation for ‘digital versatile disc’ or ‘digital videodisc’)
example: Let's just stay in and watch a DVD.
definition_zh: 一种可存储大量信息（尤其是电影、照片和视频）的光盘，可在DVD播放器或计算机上使用（“数字多功能光盘”或“数字视频光盘”的缩写）
example_zh: 咱们还是待在家里看张DVD吧。

definition: used to refer to every one of two or more people or things, when you are thinking about them separately
example: Each answer is worth 20 points.
definition_zh: 用于指代两个或两个以上的人或事物中的每一个，当你将它们分别考虑时

definition: used to refer to every one of two or more people or things, when you are thinking about them separately
example: Each answer is worth 20 points.
definition_zh: 用于指代两个或两个以上的人或事物中的每一个，当你将它们分别考虑时

definition: used to refer to every one of two or more people or things, when you are thinking about them separately
example: Each answer is worth 20 points.
definition_zh: 用于指代两个或两个以上的人或事物中的每一个，当你将它们分别考虑时

definition: either of the organs on the sides of the head that you hear with
example: the left/right ear
definition_zh: 位于头部两侧、用于听觉的任一器官

definition: near the beginning of a period of time, an event etc.
example: the early morning
definition_zh: 在某个时间段、事件等的起始阶段

definition: near the beginning of a period of time, an event, a piece of work, etc.
example: We arrived early the next day.
definition_zh: 在某个时间段、事件、作品等的开头附近。
example_zh: 第二天我们一大早就到了。

definition: in or towards the east
example: East Africa
definition_zh: 在东部或朝向东部

definition: towards the east
example: The house faces east.
definition_zh: 向东

definition: the direction that you look towards to see the sun rise; one of the four main points of the compass
example: Which way is east?
definition_zh: 观看日出时所望的方向；罗盘四大方位之一

definition: not difficult; done or obtained without a lot of effort or problems
example: an easy way to make bread
definition_zh: 不难；无需费太多力气或遇到太多困难就能完成或获得
example_zh: 一种简单的做面包的方法

definition: to put food in your mouth, bite it and swallow it
example: I was too nervous to eat.
definition_zh: 把食物放进嘴里，咬一口，然后咽下去
example_zh: 我太紧张了，连饭都吃不下。

definition: a small oval object with a thin hard shell produced by a female bird and containing a young bird; a similar object (without a hard shell) produced by a female fish, insect, etc.
example: The female sits on the eggs until they hatch.
definition_zh: 雌鸟产下的、带有薄而坚硬外壳的小型椭圆形物体，内含一只幼鸟；鱼类、昆虫等雌性个体产下的类似物体（无坚硬外壳）。
example_zh: 雌性会一直孵卵，直到卵孵化出来。

definition: the number 8
example: There are eight students in the room.
definition_zh: 数字8

definition: the number 18
example: She turned eighteen last month.
definition_zh: 数字18

definition: the number 80
example: My grandfather is eighty years old.
definition_zh: 数字80

definition: a very large animal with thick grey skin, large ears, two curved outer teeth called tusks and a long nose called a trunk. There are two types of elephant, the African and the Asian.
example: herds of elephants
definition_zh: 一种体型非常庞大的动物，皮肤厚实呈灰色，耳朵很大，有两颗弯曲的门牙，称为“象牙”，还有一条长鼻子，称为“象鼻”。大象分为两种：非洲象和亚洲象。

example: There are only eleven of these rare animals left.
example_zh: 这种珍稀动物目前仅存十一只。

definition: in addition to something already mentioned
example: What else did he say?
definition_zh: 除了前面已经提到的一点之外

definition: a way of sending messages and data to other people by means of computers connected together in a network
example: I will be on vacation for a week in November, with no access to email.
definition_zh: 一种通过联网的计算机向他人发送消息和数据的方式
example_zh: 11月我将休假一周，期间无法查看电子邮件。

definition: to send a message to somebody by email
example: email somebody, Patrick emailed me yesterday.
definition_zh: 通过电子邮件向某人发送消息
example_zh: 给某人发邮件，帕特里克昨天给我发了邮件。

definition: the final part of a period of time, an event, an activity or a story
example: It's the end of an era.
definition_zh: 一段时间、某件事、某项活动或某个故事的最后部分

definition: to finish; to reach a point and go no further; to make something finish
example: At last the war ended.
definition_zh: 结束；达到某个点后不再继续；使某事结束

definition: to get pleasure from something
example: enjoy something, We thoroughly enjoyed our time in New York.
definition_zh: 从某事中获得乐趣
example_zh: 享受某件事，我们非常享受在纽约的时光。

definition: to the necessary degree
example: I hadn't trained enough for the game.
definition_zh: 在必要的程度上
example_zh: 我为这场比赛的训练还不够充分。

definition: used before plural or uncountable nouns to mean ‘as many or as much as somebody needs or wants’
example: Have you made enough copies?
definition_zh: 用于复数名词或不可数名词之前，表示“多少都行，只要有人需要或想要”

definition: as many or as much as somebody needs or wants
example: Six bottles should be enough.
definition_zh: 无论多少，只要是某人需要的或想要的

definition: the unit of money of some countries of the European Union
example: I paid five euros for it.
definition_zh: 欧盟某些国家的货币单位

definition: used to emphasize something unexpected or surprising
example: She didn't even call to say she wasn't coming.
definition_zh: 用于强调出人意料或令人惊讶的事情
example_zh: 她连个电话都没打来说她不来了。

definition: the part of the day between the afternoon and the time you go to bed
example: Remember to call me this evening.
definition_zh: 一天中从下午到上床睡觉这段时间

definition: a thing that happens, especially something important
example: recent/current/world events
definition_zh: 发生的一件事，尤其是某件重要的事

definition: used in negative sentences and questions, or sentences with if to mean ‘at any time’
example: Nothing ever happens here.
definition_zh: 用于否定句、疑问句或含有“if”的句子中，表示“任何时候”
example_zh: 这里从来没什么事发生。

definition: used with singular nouns to refer to all the members of a group of things or people
example: She knows every student in the school.
definition_zh: 用于单数名词，指代某一组事物或人群中的所有成员
example_zh: 她认识学校里的每一个学生。

definition: every person; all people
example: Everybody knows Tom.
definition_zh: 每个人；所有人

definition: every person; all people
example: Everyone cheered and clapped.
definition_zh: 每个人；所有人
example_zh: 大家都欢呼雀跃，鼓掌欢呼。

definition: all things
example: Everything had gone.
definition_zh: 万物

definition: a formal written, spoken or practical test, especially at school or college, to see how much you know about a subject, or what you can do
example: to take an exam
definition_zh: 一种正式的书面、口头或实践考试，通常在学校或大学中进行，旨在检验你对某门学科的掌握程度，或评估你的实际能力

definition: something such as an object, a fact or a situation that shows, explains or supports what you say
example: Let me give you an example.
definition_zh: 指某物（例如一个对象、一个事实或一种情况），它能说明、解释或支持你的观点

definition: feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm
example: Staff got excited when they heard they were getting a bonus.
definition_zh: 感到或表现出快乐和热情
example_zh: 员工们一听说要发奖金，都兴奋起来。

definition: causing great interest or excitement
example: This is an exciting opportunity for me.
definition_zh: 引起极大的兴趣或兴奋
example_zh: 这对我来说是一个令人兴奋的机会。

definition: physical or mental activity that you do to stay healthy or become stronger
example: Swimming is good exercise.
definition_zh: 为了保持健康或增强体质而进行的体育或脑力活动
example_zh: 游泳是一项很好的运动。

definition: to do sports or other physical activities in order to stay healthy or become stronger; to make an animal do this
example: an hour’s class of exercising to music
definition_zh: 为了保持健康或增强体质而进行体育运动或其他体育活动；让动物进行此类活动
example_zh: 一小时跟着音乐锻炼的课程

definition: costing a lot of money
example: an expensive car/restaurant/holiday
definition_zh: 花费了大笔钱
example_zh: 一辆昂贵的车/一家昂贵的餐厅/一次昂贵的假期

definition: to tell somebody about something in a way that makes it easy to understand
example: explain (something), He was trying to explain the difference between hip hop and rap.
definition_zh: 以一种通俗易懂的方式向某人说明某事
example_zh: 解释（某事），他正试图解释嘻哈和说唱之间的区别。

definition: more than is usual, expected, or than exists already
example: extra money/cash/funding
definition_zh: 比通常情况、预期或现有情况更多

definition: either of the two organs on the face that you see with
example: The suspect has dark hair and green eyes.
definition_zh: 脸上那两个器官中的任何一个，你看到的是
example_zh: 该嫌疑人身为深色头发，绿眼睛。

definition: the front part of the head, where the eyes, nose and mouth are
example: a pretty/pale/round face
definition_zh: 头部的前部，即眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴所在的位置
example_zh: 一张漂亮/苍白/圆圆的脸

definition: a thing that is known to be true, especially when it can be proved
example: fact about something, First, some basic facts about healthy eating.
definition_zh: 已知为真的事情，尤其是能够被证明的事情
example_zh: 关于某事的知识，首先，关于健康饮食的一些基本知识。

definition: to drop down from a higher level to a lower level
example: The rain was falling steadily.
definition_zh: 从较高层次降至较低层次

definition: wrong; not correct or true
example: A whale is a fish. True or false?
definition_zh: 错误；不正确或不真实
example_zh: 鲸鱼是一种鱼。对还是错？

definition: connected with the family or a particular family
example: family life
definition_zh: 与该家庭或某个特定家庭有关

definition: a group consisting of one or two parents and their children
example: I introduced Neil to the other members of my family.
definition_zh: 由一名或两名父母及其子女组成的一组人
example_zh: 我把尼尔介绍给了家里的其他成员。

definition: known about by many people
example: a famous artist/actor
definition_zh: 为许多人所知
example_zh: 一位著名的艺术家/演员

definition: extremely good; excellent
example: He's done a fantastic job.
definition_zh: 非常好；极好

definition: a long distance away

definition: an activity that you do for pleasure when you are not working
example: Do you have any hobbies?
definition_zh: 指工作之余为消遣而进行的一项活动

definition: a period of time when you are not at work or school
example: the school/summer/Christmas holidays
definition_zh: 指不在工作或学校的一段时间
example_zh: 学校假期/暑假/圣诞假期

definition: to or at the place where you live
example: Come on, it's time to go home.
definition_zh: 到你居住的地方，或在该处

definition: the house or flat that you live in, especially with your family
example: Old people prefer to stay in their own homes.
definition_zh: 你居住的房子或公寓，尤其是与家人一起居住的
example_zh: 老年人更愿意住在自己家里。

definition: work that is given by teachers for students to do at home
example: I always do my homework on the bus.
definition_zh: 老师布置给学生在家完成的作业
example_zh: 我总是坐公交车时做作业。

definition: to want something to happen and think that it is possible
example: All we can do now is wait and hope.
definition_zh: 希望某事发生，并认为这是可能的
example_zh: 眼下我们只能等待并抱有希望。

definition: a large animal with four legs, a mane (= long thick hair on its neck) and a tail. Horses are used for riding on, pulling carriages, etc.
example: to ride a horse
definition_zh: 一种体型庞大的四足动物，有鬃毛（即颈部浓密的长毛）和尾巴。马可用于骑乘、拉车等。

definition: a large building where people who are ill or injured are given medical treatment and care
example: to/into (the) hospital, (British English), He had to go to/into hospital for treatment.
definition_zh: 一栋大型建筑，供患病或受伤的人在此接受医疗救治和护理
example_zh: to/into (the) hospital（英式英语），他不得不去医院接受治疗。

definition: having a high temperature; producing heat
example: It's hot today, isn't it?
definition_zh: 体温高；产生热量

definition: a building where people stay, usually for a short time, paying for their rooms and meals
example: a two-star/five-star, etc. hotel
definition_zh: 供人们居住的建筑，通常是短期住宿，住客需支付房费和餐费
example_zh: 一家二星级/五星级等酒店

definition: 60 minutes; one of the 24 parts that a day is divided into
example: I spent an hour on the phone.
definition_zh: 60分钟；一天划分的24个部分之一
example_zh: 我在电话上花了一个小时。

definition: a building for people to live in, usually for one family
example: in a house, We live in a two-bedroom house.
definition_zh: 供人们居住的建筑，通常供一个家庭居住
example_zh: 在一栋房子里，我们住在一栋有两间卧室的房子里。

definition: in what way or manner
example: How does it work?
definition_zh: 以何种方式或方法

definition: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with something that has just been said
example: He was feeling bad. He went to work, however, and tried to concentrate.
definition_zh: 用于引出与前文内容形成对比的陈述
example_zh: 他感觉不太舒服。不过，他还是去上班了，并努力集中注意力。

example: One hundred (of the children) have already been placed with foster families.
example_zh: 其中一百名（儿童）已被安置在寄养家庭中。

definition: feeling that you want to eat something
example: I'm really hungry.
definition_zh: 想吃点什么的感觉

definition: the man that somebody is married to; a married man
example: This is my husband, Steve.
definition_zh: 某人的丈夫；已婚男子

definition: used as the subject of a verb when the speaker or writer is referring to himself/herself
example: I think I'd better go now.
definition_zh: 当说话者或写作者指代自己时，用作动词的宾语

definition: water that has frozen and become solid
example: There was ice on the windows.
definition_zh: 水冻结后形成的固体

definition: a type of sweet frozen food made from milk fat, tasting of fruit, chocolate, etc. and often eaten as a dessert; a small amount of this food intended for one person, often served in a container made of biscuit that is like a cone in shape
example: Desserts are served with cream or ice cream.
definition_zh: 一种由乳脂制成的甜味冷冻食品，带有水果、巧克力等风味，通常作为甜点食用；这种食品的份量较小，供一人食用，通常盛放在类似锥形的饼干容器中
example_zh: 甜点通常配以鲜奶油或冰淇淋。

definition: a plan, thought or suggestion, especially about what to do in a particular situation
example: It would be a good idea to call before we leave.
definition_zh: 计划、想法或建议，尤其是关于在特定情况下该怎么做
example_zh: 在出发前打个电话是个好主意。

definition: used to say that one thing can, will or might happen or be true, depending on another thing happening or being true
example: If you see him, give him this note.
definition_zh: 用于表示某件事是否会发生或是否属实，取决于另一件事是否发生或是否属实
example_zh: 如果你见到他，就把这张纸条给他。

definition: to form a picture in your mind of what something might be like
example: imagine something, The house was just as she had imagined it.
definition_zh: 在脑海中勾勒出某事可能是什么样子的画面
example_zh: 想象一下，那栋房子完全就像她想象中的一样。

definition: having a great effect on people or things; of great value
example: an important issue/question/point/factor
definition_zh: 对人或事物产生重大影响；具有极高价值
example_zh: 一个重要问题/议题/要点/因素

definition: to become better than before; to make something/somebody better than before
example: Overall the situation has improved dramatically.
definition_zh: 变得比以前更好；使某事/某人比以前更好
example_zh: 总体而言，情况已大幅好转。

definition: into an object, an area or a substance
example: She opened the door and went in.
definition_zh: 进入一个物体、一个区域或一种物质

definition: at a point within an area or a space
example: a country in Africa
definition_zh: 位于某个区域或空间内的某一点

definition: if one thing includes another, it has the second thing as one of its parts
example: include something, The tour included a visit to the Science Museum.
definition_zh: 如果某物包含另一物，则该物将后者作为其组成部分之一
example_zh: 包括……，此次游览包括参观科学博物馆。

definition: facts or details about somebody/something
example: a piece of information
definition_zh: 关于某人或某事的事实或细节

definition: the feeling that you have when you want to know or learn more about somebody/something
example: Her research has generated interest around the world.
definition_zh: 当你想进一步了解某人或某事时所产生的那种感觉
example_zh: 她的研究引起了全球的关注。

definition: to attract your attention and make you feel interested; to make yourself give your attention to something
example: interest somebody, Politics doesn't interest me.
definition_zh: 为了吸引你的注意并引起你的兴趣；为了让你把注意力集中在某件事上
example_zh: 有人感兴趣，但我对政治不感兴趣。

definition: giving your attention to something because you enjoy finding out about it or doing it; showing interest in something and finding it exciting
example: He sounded genuinely interested.
definition_zh: 因为喜欢了解或做某事而将注意力放在它上面；对某事表现出兴趣并觉得它令人兴奋
example_zh: 他听起来确实很感兴趣。

definition: attracting your attention because it is/they are special, exciting or unusual
example: The article raises several interesting questions.
definition_zh: 因为它/它们特别、令人兴奋或与众不同，从而引起你的注意
example_zh: 这篇文章提出了一些有趣的问题。

definition: an international computer network connecting other networks and computers that allows people to share information around the world
example: to surf/browse/access the internet
definition_zh: 一个连接其他网络和计算机的国际计算机网络，使人们能够在全球范围内共享信息

definition: a formal meeting at which somebody is asked questions to see if they are suitable for a particular job, or for a course of study at a college, university, etc.
example: a job interview
definition_zh: 一种正式的面试，旨在通过向某人提问，以评估其是否适合某份工作，或适合进入学院、大学等机构攻读某门课程。

definition: to talk to somebody and ask them questions at a formal meeting to find out if they are suitable for a job, course of study, etc.
example: interview somebody, The university interviews all potential candidates.
definition_zh: 在正式会议上与某人交谈并向其提问，以了解其是否适合某份工作、某门课程等。
example_zh: 面试某人，该大学会对所有潜在候选人进行面试。

definition: to a position in or inside something
example: Come into the house.
definition_zh: 位于某物之中或内部的位置

definition: to tell two or more people who have not met before what each other’s names are; to tell somebody what your name is
example: introduce somebody, Allow me to introduce my mother.
definition_zh: 向两个或两个以上素未谋面的人介绍彼此的名字；向某人报上自己的名字
example_zh: 介绍某人，请允许我介绍一下我的母亲。

definition: a piece of land that is completely surrounded by water
example: a small/tiny island
definition_zh: 一块四面环水的土地

definition: used to refer to an animal or a thing that has already been mentioned or that is being talked about now
example: ‘Where's your car?’ ‘It's in the garage.’
definition_zh: 用于指代已经提过或正在谈论的动物或事物

definition: belonging to or connected with a thing, an animal or a baby
example: Turn the box on its side.
definition_zh: 属于或与某物、某动物或某婴儿有关的

definition: a piece of clothing worn on the top half of the body over a shirt, etc. that has arms and fastens down the front; a short, light coat
example: a leather/denim/tweed jacket
definition_zh: 一种穿在上半身、套在衬衫等衣物外面的服装，带有袖子，并在前面系扣；一种短款轻便的外套
example_zh: 一件皮革/牛仔布/粗花呢夹克

definition: the 1st month of the year, between December and February
example: She was born in January.
definition_zh: 一年中的第一个月，介于12月和2月之间

definition: trousers made of denim (= a type of strong cotton)
example: I always wear jeans.
definition_zh: 用牛仔布（即一种结实的棉布）制成的裤子

definition: work for which you receive regular payment
example: I don't have a job at present.
definition_zh: 您能从中获得定期报酬的工作

definition: to fix or connect two or more things together
example: join A to/onto B, Join one section of pipe to the next.
definition_zh: 将两个或多个物体固定或连接在一起
example_zh: 将A与B连接，将一段管道与下一段管道连接。

definition: an act of travelling from one place to another, especially when they are far apart
example: They went on a long train journey across India.
definition_zh: 从一地前往另一地的行为，尤其是当两地相距较远时
example_zh: 他们踏上了穿越印度的漫长火车之旅。

definition: the liquid that comes from fruit or vegetables; a drink made from this
example: a glass of fruit juice
definition_zh: 从水果或蔬菜中提取的液体；用这种液体制成的饮料

definition: the 7th month of the year, between June and August
example: in July, She was born in July.
definition_zh: 该年的第7个月，介于6月和8月之间

definition: the 6th month of the year, between May and July
example: She was born in June.
definition_zh: 该年的第6个月，介于5月和7月之间

definition: only
example: There is just one method that might work.
definition_zh: 仅
example_zh: 只有一种方法可能有效。

definition: to continue to have something and not give it back or throw it away
example: He kept all her letters.
definition_zh: 继续拥有某样东西，既不归还也不丢弃
example_zh: 他把她的所有信都留了下来。

definition: most important; essential
example: the key issue/factor/point
definition_zh: 最重要的；必不可少的

definition: a piece of metal with a special shape used for locking a door, starting a car, etc.
example: to put/turn the key in the lock
definition_zh: 一种形状特殊的金属片，用于锁门、启动汽车等。
example_zh: 将钥匙插入锁孔/转动钥匙

definition: a unit for measuring distance; 1 000 metres
example: The industrial estate is 6 kilometres from the city centre.
definition_zh: 一种距离单位；1 000 米
example_zh: 该工业园区距离市中心6公里。

definition: a group of people or things that are the same in some way; a particular variety or type
example: kind of somebody/something, three kinds of cakes/cake
definition_zh: 在某些方面具有共同特征的一群人或事物；某种特定的种类或类型
example_zh: 某类人/某类事物，三种蛋糕/一种蛋糕

definition: a room in which meals are cooked or prepared
example: We ate at the kitchen table.
definition_zh: 用于烹饪或准备餐食的房间
example_zh: 我们在厨房的餐桌旁吃了饭。

definition: to have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it
example: know something, No one knows the answer.
definition_zh: 由于经验，或者因为学习或被告知，而将信息记在脑海中
example_zh: 知道些什么，其实谁都不知道答案。

definition: the surface of the earth that is not sea
example: The new project will reclaim the land from the sea.
definition_zh: 地球上除海洋以外的陆地
example_zh: 这个新项目将从海中填海造地。

definition: the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area
example: the English language
definition_zh: 某个国家或地区的人们所使用的口头和书面交流体系

definition: big in size or quantity
example: a large group/city/area/crowd/family
definition_zh: 体积或数量很大
example_zh: 一大群人/城市/地区/人群/家庭

definition: happening or coming after all other similar things or people
example: We caught the last bus home.
definition_zh: 发生在所有其他类似事物或人之后，或者紧随其后
example_zh: 我们赶上了回家的末班车。

definition: arriving, happening or done after the expected, arranged or usual time
example: I'm sorry I'm late.
definition_zh: 在预期、约定或通常时间之后到达、发生或完成

definition: after the expected, arranged or usual time
example: I got up late.
definition_zh: 在预期、约定或通常的时间之后

definition: at a time in the future; after the time you are talking about
example: See you later.
definition_zh: 在未来的某个时候；在你所说的那个时间之后

definition: the sound you make when you think that something is funny or silly
example: to give a laugh
definition_zh: 当你觉得某件事好笑或傻气时发出的声音

definition: to make the sounds and movements of your face that show you think something is funny or silly
example: to laugh out loud
definition_zh: 做出能表达你觉得某件事好笑或傻气的面部表情和动作

definition: to gain knowledge or skill by studying, from experience, from being taught, etc.
example: learn something, to learn a language/skill/trade
definition_zh: 通过学习、实践、受教等方式获得知识或技能。
example_zh: 学点东西，学习一门语言/技能/手艺

definition: to go away from a person or a place
example: Come on, it's time we left (= time for us to leave).
definition_zh: 离开某人或某地
example_zh: 来吧，该走了（= 我们该走了）。

definition: on the side of your body that is towards the west when you are facing north
example: Fewer people write with their left hand than with their right.
definition_zh: 当你面向北方时，身体朝向西侧的那一边
example_zh: 用左手写字的人比用右手写字的人少。

definition: on or to the left side
example: Turn left at the intersection.
definition_zh: 在……上或左侧

definition: the left side or direction
example: on the left, Take the next road on the left.
definition_zh: 左侧或方向
example_zh: 在左侧，沿左侧下一条路前行。

definition: one of the long parts that connect the feet to the rest of the body
example: Sit on the floor, stretching your legs out in front of you.
definition_zh: 连接脚与身体其他部位的较长部分之一
example_zh: 坐在地板上，双腿向前伸直。

definition: a period of time in which somebody is taught something
example: She gives piano lessons.
definition_zh: 某人接受某项知识或技能培训的一段时间

definition: used for making suggestions or as a polite way of telling people what you want them to do
example: ‘Shall we check it again?’ ‘Yes, let's.’
definition_zh: 用于提出建议，或作为一种礼貌的方式来告诉别人你希望他们做什么
example_zh: “我们再检查一下好吗？”“好，我们再检查一下吧。”

definition: a written, typed or printed message that is put in an envelope or attached to an email and sent to somebody
example: to write/send (somebody) a letter
definition_zh: 写在纸上、打字或打印的讯息，装入信封或作为电子邮件附件发送给某人

definition: a building in which collections of books, newspapers, etc. and sometimes films and recorded music are kept for people to read, study or borrow
example: a public/university/school library
definition_zh: 一座用于收藏书籍、报纸等，有时还收藏电影和录音资料，供人们阅读、研究或借阅的建筑
example_zh: 公共图书馆/大学图书馆/学校图书馆

definition: to be or put yourself in a flat position so that you are not standing or sitting
example: lie + adv./prep., to lie on your back/side/front
definition_zh: 保持或让自己处于平躺的姿势，即既不站立也不坐着
example_zh: lie + 副词/介词，指仰卧/侧卧/俯卧

definition: the ability to breathe, grow, produce young, etc. that people, animals and plants have before they die and that objects do not have
example: This could mean the difference between life and death.
definition_zh: 人类、动物和植物在死亡之前所具备的、而物体所不具备的呼吸、生长、繁殖等能力

definition: pale in colour
example: He's got light blue eyes.
definition_zh: 颜色浅
example_zh: 他有一双浅蓝色的眼睛。

definition: the energy from the sun, a lamp, etc. that makes it possible to see things
example: bright/dim light
definition_zh: 来自太阳、灯等光源的能量，使人们能够看清事物

definition: similar to somebody/something
example: She's wearing a dress like mine.
definition_zh: 与某人/某物相似
example_zh: 她穿的裙子跟我的一样。

definition: to find somebody/something pleasant, attractive or of a good enough standard; to enjoy something
example: like somebody/something, She's nice. I like her.
definition_zh: 觉得某人/某物令人愉快、有吸引力或水平足够高；对某事感到满意
example_zh: 喜欢某人/某事，她人很好。我喜欢她。

definition: a long, thin mark on a surface
example: a straight/solid/dotted/dashed line
definition_zh: 表面上的一道细长的痕迹

definition: a large, powerful animal of the cat family that hunts in groups and lives in parts of Africa and southern Asia. Lions have yellow-brown fur and the male has a mane (= long, thick hair round its neck).
example: The lion shook its mane and roared.
definition_zh: 猫科的一种体型庞大、力量强大的动物，通常群居狩猎，栖息于非洲和南亚的部分地区。狮子身上长着黄褐色的皮毛，雄狮颈部周围长有鬃毛（即颈部周围长而浓密的毛发）。
example_zh: 狮子抖了抖鬃毛，发出了一声咆哮。

definition: a series of names, items, figures, etc., especially when they are written or printed
example: The guest list includes numerous celebrities.
definition_zh: 一系列名称、项目、数字等，尤其是以书写或印刷形式呈现时
example_zh: 宾客名单上包括众多名人。

definition: to write a list of things in a particular order
example: We were asked to list our ten favourite songs.
definition_zh: 按特定顺序列出一份清单
example_zh: 有人让我们列出自己最喜欢的十首歌。

definition: to pay attention to somebody/something that you can hear
example: Listen! What's that noise? Can you hear it?
definition_zh: 留意你能听到的某人或某事
example_zh: 听！那是什么声音？你听到了吗？

definition: not big; small; smaller than others
example: a little house
definition_zh: 不大；小；比其他的小

definition: used with uncountable nouns to mean ‘a small amount’, ‘some’
example: a little milk/sugar/tea
definition_zh: 用于不可数名词，表示“少量”、“一些”

definition: used with uncountable nouns to mean ‘a small amount’, ‘some’
example: a little milk/sugar/tea
definition_zh: 用于不可数名词，表示“少量”、“一些”

definition: to have your home in a particular place
example: to live in a house/a flat/an apartment
definition_zh: 在某个地方安家
example_zh: 住在一栋房子里/一间公寓里

definition: belonging to or connected with the particular place or area that you are talking about or with the place where you live
example: local people/residents/businesses
definition_zh: 属于或与你正在谈论的特定地点或地区有关，或与你居住的地方有关

definition: measuring or covering a great length or distance, or a greater length or distance than usual
example: She had long dark hair.
definition_zh: 指长度或距离很大，或比通常情况更长、更远

definition: for a long time
example: Have you been here long?
definition_zh: 很长一段时间

definition: to turn your eyes in a particular direction
example: Look closely and tell me what you see.
definition_zh: 将视线转向某个方向
example_zh: 仔细看看，然后告诉我你看到了什么。

definition: to be unable to find something/somebody
example: I've lost my keys.
definition_zh: 找不到某物/某人

definition: used with verbs to mean ‘a great amount’
example: I care a lot about you.
definition_zh: 与动词连用时，表示“大量”

definition: a large number or amount of somebody/something
example: What a lot of presents!
definition_zh: 大量的人或事物

definition: a large number or amount
example: ‘How many do you need?’ ‘A lot.’
definition_zh: 大量或大数

definition: a very strong feeling of liking and caring for somebody/something, especially a member of your family or a friend
example: She has earned the love and respect of many people.
definition_zh: 对某人或某事——尤其是家人或朋友——怀有非常强烈的喜爱和关怀之情
example_zh: 她赢得了许多人的爱戴和尊重。

definition: to have very strong feelings of liking and caring for somebody
example: I love you.
definition_zh: 对某人怀有非常强烈的喜爱和关怀之情

definition: a meal eaten in the middle of the day
example: She's gone to lunch.
definition_zh: 中午吃的一顿饭

definition: a piece of equipment with many parts that work together to do a particular task. The power used to work a machine may be electricity, steam, gas, etc. or human power.
example: Machines have replaced human labour in many industries.
definition_zh: 一种由许多部件组成、共同协作以完成特定任务的设备。驱动机器运行的动力可以是电力、蒸汽、燃气等，也可以是人力。
example_zh: 在许多行业中，机器已经取代了人力劳动。

definition: a type of large thin book with a paper cover that you can buy every week or month, containing articles, photographs, etc., often on a particular topic; a similar collection of articles, etc. that appears regularly online
example: a weekly/monthly magazine
definition_zh: 一种纸质封面、薄而大开本的刊物，每周或每月发行一次，内容包括文章、照片等，通常围绕特定主题；网上定期发布的、类似的文章集等内容

definition: being the largest or most important of its kind
example: Be careful crossing the main road.
definition_zh: 指同类中规模最大或地位最重要的

definition: to create or prepare something by combining materials or putting parts together
example: make something, to make a table/dress/cake
definition_zh: 通过组合材料或将部件拼装在一起来制作或准备某物
example_zh: 制作某物，例如制作桌子、连衣裙或蛋糕

definition: an adult male human
example: a good-looking young man
definition_zh: 一名成年男性

definition: used with plural nouns and verbs, especially in negative sentences or in more formal English, to mean ‘a large number of’. Also used in questions to ask about the size of a number, and with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.
example: We don't have very many copies left.
definition_zh: 用于复数名词和动词，尤其在否定句或较为正式的英语中，意为“大量”。也可用于疑问句中询问数量大小，并常与“as”、“so”和“too”搭配使用。
example_zh: 我们剩下的库存已经不多了。

definition: used with plural nouns and verbs, especially in negative sentences or in more formal English, to mean ‘a large number of’. Also used in questions to ask about the size of a number, and with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.
example: We don't have very many copies left.
definition_zh: 用于复数名词和动词，尤其在否定句或较为正式的英语中，意为“大量”。也可用于疑问句中询问数量大小，并常与“as”、“so”和“too”搭配使用。
example_zh: 我们剩下的存货已经不多了。

definition: a drawing or plan of the earth’s surface or part of it, showing countries, towns, rivers, etc.
example: a map of France
definition_zh: 地球表面或其部分的图画或图示，上面标有国家、城镇、河流等。

definition: the 3rd month of the year, between February and April
example: She was born in March.
definition_zh: 这一年的第三个月，介于2月和4月之间

definition: an occasion when people buy and sell goods; the open area or building where they meet to do this
example: a fruit/flower/fish market
definition_zh: 人们买卖商品的场合；人们为此聚集的露天场所或建筑物

definition: having a husband or wife
example: a married man/woman
definition_zh: 有丈夫或妻子

definition: a sports event where people or teams compete against each other
example: (British English), a football match
definition_zh: 一项人们或队伍之间相互竞技的体育赛事

definition: to find somebody/something that goes together with or is connected with another person or thing
example: match A and B, Match the words and pictures.
definition_zh: 找到与另一个人或事物相配或相关的人或事物
example_zh: 将A和B配对，将单词和图片配对。

definition: the fifth month of the year, between April and June
example: She was born in May.
definition_zh: 一年中的第五个月，介于4月和6月之间

definition: used when you are not certain that something will happen or that something is true or is a correct number
example: Maybe he'll come, maybe he won't.
definition_zh: 用于表示不确定某事是否会发生、某事是否属实，或者某个数字是否正确

definition: the form of I that is used when the speaker or writer is the object of a verb or preposition, or after the verb be
example: Don't hit me.
definition_zh: 当说话者或写作者是动词或介词的宾语时，或在动词“be”之后使用的一种“I”的形式

definition: an occasion when people eat food, especially breakfast, lunch or dinner
example: Try not to eat between meals.
definition_zh: 人们进食的场合，尤其是早餐、午餐或晚餐
example_zh: 尽量不要在正餐之间进食。

definition: to have something as a meaning in the same or another language
example: mean something, What does this sentence mean?
definition_zh: 在同一语言或另一种语言中具有某种含义

definition: the thing or idea that a sound, word, sign, etc. represents
example: What's the meaning of this word?
definition_zh: 声音、词语、符号等所代表的事物或概念

definition: the soft part of an animal or a bird that can be eaten as food; a particular type of this
example: a piece/slice of meat
definition_zh: 动物或鸟类中可作为食物食用的软组织；此类组织中的一种特定类型

definition: to be in the same place as somebody by chance and talk to them
example: Maybe we'll meet again some time.
definition_zh: 偶然与某人出现在同一个地方并和对方交谈
example_zh: 也许我们以后还会再见。

definition: an occasion when people come together to discuss or decide something
example: A hundred people attended the public meeting.
definition_zh: 人们聚在一起讨论或决定某事的场合
example_zh: 有100人参加了这次公众会议。

definition: a person, an animal or a plant that belongs to a particular group
example: member of something, a member of the family/community
definition_zh: 属于某个特定群体的生物、动物或植物
example_zh: 某事的一员，家庭/社区的一员

definition: a list of the food that is available at a restaurant or to be served at a meal
example: May we have the menu?
definition_zh: 一家餐厅提供的或将在某顿饭中供应的菜肴清单

definition: a written or spoken piece of information, etc. that you send to somebody or leave for somebody when you cannot speak to them yourself
example: There were no messages for me at the hotel.
definition_zh: 当你无法亲自与某人交谈时，发送给对方或留给对方的书面或口头信息等
example_zh: 酒店里没有留给我的留言。

definition: a unit for measuring length; a hundred centimetres
example: a 50-metre swimming pool
definition_zh: 一种长度单位；一百厘米

definition: 12 o’clock at night
example: She heard the clock strike midnight.
definition_zh: 午夜12点
example_zh: 她听见时钟敲响了午夜十二点。

definition: a unit for measuring distance equal to 1 609 metres or 1 760 yards
example: a 20-mile drive to work
definition_zh: 一种距离单位，等于1 609米或1 760码

definition: the white liquid produced by cows, goats and some other animals as food for their young and used as a drink by humans
example: a pint/litre of milk
definition_zh: 牛、山羊和其他一些动物分泌的一种白色液体，既作为其幼崽的食物，也供人类饮用

example: a population of half a million

definition: each of the 60 parts of an hour, that are equal to 60 seconds
example: minutes to…, It's four minutes to six.
definition_zh: 一小时的60个部分，每个部分等于60秒
example_zh: 还有……分钟……，现在离六点还有四分钟。

definition: to be or arrive too late for something
example: If I don't leave now I'll miss my plane.
definition_zh: 因某事而来得太晚或赶不上
example_zh: 如果我现在不走，就会错过飞机。

definition: an action or an opinion that is not correct, or that produces a result that you did not want
