example: It's easy to make a mistake.
definition_zh: 一种不正确的行为或观点，或者会导致你未预期的结果

definition: a copy of something, usually smaller than the original object
example: a working model (= one in which the parts move) of a fire engine
definition_zh: 某物的复制品，通常比原件小
example_zh: 一辆消防车的可动模型（即各部件可以活动的模型）

definition: of the present time or recent times
example: the modern industrial world
definition_zh: 当今或近期的

definition: a very short period of time
example: Could you wait a moment, please?
definition_zh: 很短的一段时间

definition: the day of the week after Sunday and before Tuesday, the first day of the working week
example: It's Monday today, isn't it?
definition_zh: 星期日之后、星期二之前的那一天，即工作周的第一天

definition: what you earn by working or selling things, and use to buy things
example: to borrow/save/spend/earn money
definition_zh: 通过工作或出售物品赚取的收入，用于购买物品

definition: any of the twelve periods of time into which the year is divided, for example May or June
example: The months of July and August are the hottest.
definition_zh: 一年被划分为的十二个时间段中的任何一个，例如五月或六月

definition: used to form the comparative of most adjectives and adverbs with two or more syllables
example: She was far more intelligent than her sister.
definition_zh: 用于构成大多数两个或两个以上音节的形容词和副词的比较级

definition: a larger number or amount of
example: I want some more!
definition_zh: 数量或数量更多的

definition: a larger number or amount of people or things
example: More of us are using public transport.
definition_zh: 人数或事物数量更多
example_zh: 越来越多的人开始乘坐公共交通工具。

definition: the early part of the day from the time when people wake up until 12 o'clock in the middle of the day or before lunch
example: They left for Spain early this morning.
definition_zh: 一天的早些时候，从人们醒来之时起，直到中午12点或午餐前
example_zh: 他们今天一大早动身前往西班牙了。

definition: used to form the superlative of most adjectives and adverbs of two or more syllables
example: the most boring/beautiful part
definition_zh: 用于构成大多数两个或两个以上音节的形容词和副词的最高级形式

definition: the largest in number or amount
example: Who do you think will get (the) most votes?
definition_zh: 数量或金额最大
example_zh: 你觉得谁会获得最多票数？

definition: the largest number or amount
example: Who ate the most?
definition_zh: 最大的数值或数量

definition: a female parent of a child or animal; a person who is acting as a mother to a child
example: I want to buy a present for my mother and father.
definition_zh: 儿童或动物的母亲；像母亲一样照顾孩子的人
example_zh: 我想给爸爸妈妈买一份礼物。

definition: a very high hill, often with rocks near the top
example: the mountains of Andalusia
definition_zh: 一座非常高的山丘，山顶附近常有岩石

definition: a small animal that is covered in fur and has a long thin tail. Mice live in fields, in people’s houses or where food is stored.
example: a house mouse
definition_zh: 一种全身长满毛发、尾巴细长的动物。老鼠栖息在田野里、人们的房屋中或食物储存的地方。

definition: the opening in the face used for speaking, eating, etc.; the area inside the head behind this opening
example: She opened her mouth to say something.
definition_zh: 面部用于说话、进食等的开口；该开口后方颅腔内的区域
example_zh: 她张了张嘴，正要说些什么。

definition: to change position or make somebody/something change position in a way that can be seen, heard or felt
example: Don't move—stay perfectly still.
definition_zh: 以一种能够被看到、听到或感觉到的方式改变位置，或使某人/某物改变位置

definition: a series of moving pictures recorded with sound that tells a story, watched at a movie theater or on a television or other device
example: You'll love this movie.
definition_zh: 一系列带有声音的动态画面，讲述一个故事，可在电影院、电视或其他设备上观看

definition: to a great degree
example: Thank you very much for the flowers.
definition_zh: 在很大程度上

definition: used with uncountable nouns, especially in negative sentences to mean ‘a large amount of something’, or after ‘how’ to ask about the amount of something. It is also used with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.
example: I don't have much money with me.
definition_zh: 用于不可数名词，特别是在否定句中表示“大量某物”，或跟在“how”后面询问某物的数量。它也可与“as”、“so”和“too”连用。

definition: a large amount
example: I don't eat much.
definition_zh: 一大笔

definition: a mother
example: Call your mum.
definition_zh: 一位母亲

definition: a building in which objects of artistic, cultural, historical or scientific interest are kept and shown to the public
example: a museum of modern art
definition_zh: 一座用于收藏并向公众展示具有艺术、文化、历史或科学价值的物品的建筑

definition: sounds that are arranged in a way that is pleasant or exciting to listen to. People sing music or play it on instruments.
example: I like any kind of pop or dance music.
definition_zh: 以一种令人愉悦或激动的方式排列的音响。人们通过歌唱或演奏乐器来表现音乐。
example_zh: 我喜欢任何类型的流行音乐或舞曲。

definition: used to say that something is necessary or very important (sometimes involving a rule or a law)
example: All visitors must report to reception.
definition_zh: 用于表示某事是必要的或非常重要的（有时涉及规则或法律）
example_zh: 所有访客必须到前台报到。

definition: of or belonging to the speaker or writer
example: Where's my passport?
definition_zh: 属于说话者或写作者

definition: a word or words that a particular person, animal, place or thing is known by
example: What's your name?
definition_zh: 指特定的人、动物、地点或事物所使用的名称

definition: to give a name to somebody/something
example: name somebody/something (after somebody), He was named after his father (= given his father's first name).
definition_zh: 给某人/某物起个名字
example_zh: 以某人/某物命名（以某人命名），他是以父亲的名字命名的（= 取了父亲的名字）。

definition: existing in nature; not made or caused by humans
example: the natural world (= of trees, rivers, animals and birds)
definition_zh: 自然界中本就存在；非人为制造或造成
example_zh: 自然界（即树木、河流、动物和鸟类）

definition: a short distance away
example: His house is very near.
definition_zh: 不远处

definition: at a short distance away
example: A bomb exploded somewhere near.
definition_zh: 在不远处
example_zh: 附近某处发生了一起爆炸。

definition: at a short distance away from somebody/something
example: Do you live near here?
definition_zh: 离某人/某物不远的地方

definition: to require something/somebody because they are essential or very important, not just because you would like to have them
example: need something/somebody, Do you need any help?
definition_zh: 因为某物或某人不可或缺或非常重要而必须拥有，而不是仅仅因为你想要拥有它们
example_zh: 需要什么/谁，你需要帮忙吗？

definition: bad or harmful
example: The crisis had a negative effect on trade.
definition_zh: 糟糕的或有害的
example_zh: 这场危机对贸易产生了负面影响。

definition: a person who lives next to you or near you
example: We've had a lot of support from all our friends and neighbours.
definition_zh: 与你住在一起或住在你附近的人
example_zh: 我们得到了所有朋友和邻居的大力支持。

definition: not at any time; not on any occasion
example: You never help me.
definition_zh: 绝不；无论何时何地

definition: not existing before; recently made, invented, introduced, etc.
example: Have you read her new novel?
definition_zh: 以前不存在；最近才制作、发明、引入等。

definition: new information about something that has happened recently
example: What's the latest news?
definition_zh: 关于最近发生的一件事的新信息

definition: a set of large printed sheets of paper, or a website, containing news, articles, advertisements, etc. and published every day or every week; the organization responsible for producing this
example: a daily/weekly newspaper
definition_zh: 一套印有新闻、文章、广告等内容的大张印刷纸张，或一个网站，每天或每周出版一次；负责制作该出版物的机构

definition: coming straight after somebody/something in time, order or space
example: The next train to Baltimore is at ten.
definition_zh: 在时间、顺序或空间上紧随某人/某物之后
example_zh: 开往巴尔的摩的下一班火车是十点。

definition: after something else; then; afterwards
example: What happened next?
definition_zh: 之后；然后；随后

definition: in or into a position right by somebody/something
example: We sat next to each other.
definition_zh: 位于某人/某物旁边的位置

definition: pleasant or attractive
example: a nice day/smile/place
definition_zh: 令人愉快的或有吸引力的

definition: the time between one day and the next when it is dark, when people usually sleep
example: at night, These animals only come out at night.
definition_zh: 一天结束到第二天开始之间的那段时间，天色已暗，人们通常都在睡觉
example_zh: 在晚上，这些动物只在晚上出来。

example: There are only nine of these rare animals left.
example_zh: 这种珍稀动物目前仅存九只。

definition: the number 19
example: There are nineteen books on the shelf.
definition_zh: 数字19

example: The temperature must be in the nineties today.
example_zh: 今天的温度肯定在90多度。

definition: not one; not any; not a
example: No student is to leave the room.
definition_zh: 一个也没有；一个都没有；连一个都没有
example_zh: 任何学生都不得离开教室。

definition: used to give a negative reply or statement
example: Just say yes or no.
definition_zh: 用于表示否定或作出否定陈述

definition: not anyone; no person
example: No one was at home.
definition_zh: 不是任何人；没有一个人

definition: not anyone; no person
example: Nobody knew what to say.
definition_zh: 不是任何人；没有一个人

definition: in or towards the north
example: North London
definition_zh: 在北方或朝向北方

definition: towards the north
example: The house faces north.
definition_zh: 向北

definition: the direction that is on your left when you watch the sun rise; one of the four main points of the compass
example: Which way is north?
definition_zh: 观看日出时位于你左侧的方向；罗盘四大方位之一

definition: the part of the face that sticks out above the mouth, used for breathing and smelling things
example: She had dark eyes and a long narrow nose.
definition_zh: 位于嘴巴上方、从面部凸出的部位，用于呼吸和嗅闻气味
example_zh: 她有一双深色的眼睛和一张细长的鼻子。

definition: used with be, do or have to form the negative of verbs; used to form the negative of modal verbs like can or must
example: She did not/didn’t see him.
definition_zh: 与“be”、“do”或“have”连用，用于构成动词的否定形式；用于构成“can”或“must”等情态动词的否定形式

definition: a short piece of writing to help you remember something
example: Please make a note of the dates.
definition_zh: 一篇简短的文章，帮助你记住某些事情

definition: not anything; no single thing
example: There was nothing in her bag.
definition_zh: 不是任何东西；没有任何一样东西

definition: the 11th month of the year, between October and December
example: She was born in November.
definition_zh: 一年中的第11个月，介于10月和12月之间

definition: (at) the present time
example: Where are you living now?
definition_zh: (at) 目前

definition: a word or symbol that represents an amount or a quantity
example: Think of a number and multiply it by two.
definition_zh: 代表金额或数量的词语或符号
example_zh: 想一个数，然后把它乘以二。

definition: a person whose job is to take care of sick or injured people, usually in a hospital
example: a registered nurse
definition_zh: 以照顾生病或受伤的人为职业的人，通常在医院工作

definition: used with the numbers 1 to 12 when telling the time, to mean an exact hour
example: He left between five and six o'clock.
definition_zh: 在报时中与数字1至12搭配使用，表示整点
example_zh: 他是在五点到六点之间离开的。

definition: a thing that can be seen and touched, but is not alive
example: everyday objects such as cups and saucers
definition_zh: 一种既能被看见又能被触摸，但没有生命的东西

definition: the 10th month of the year, between September and November
example: She was born in October.
definition_zh: 这一年的第10个月，介于9月和11月之间

definition: belonging to somebody; relating to somebody
example: a friend of mine
definition_zh: 属于某人；与某人有关

definition: used to say that something has been removed or become separated
example: He's had his beard shaved off.
definition_zh: 用于表示某物已被移除或与之分离

definition: down or away from a place or at a distance in space or time
example: I fell off the ladder.
definition_zh: 向下、远离某处，或在空间或时间上处于一定距离之外

definition: a room, set of rooms or building where people work, usually sitting at desks
example: The company is moving to new offices on the other side of town.
definition_zh: 供人们工作（通常是坐在办公桌前）的房间、一组房间或建筑物
example_zh: 该公司即将搬迁至城另一边的新办公地点。

definition: many times
example: We often go there.
definition_zh: 很多次

definition: used when you are reacting to something that has been said, especially if you did not know it before
example: ‘I saw Ben yesterday.’ ‘Oh yes, how is he?’
definition_zh: 用于回应某人说的话，尤其是当你之前并不知道这件事时
example_zh: “我昨天见到本了。”“哦，是吗？他最近怎么样？”

definition: safe and well; in a calm or happy state
example: Are you OK?
definition_zh: 平安无事；处于平静或快乐的状态

definition: safe and well; in a calm or happy state
example: Are you OK?
definition_zh: 平安无事；处于平静或快乐的状态

definition: yes; all right
example: ‘Shall we go for a walk?’ ‘OK.’
definition_zh: 是的；好的

definition: of a particular age
example: be… years, months, etc. old, The baby was only a few hours old.
definition_zh: 处于某个年龄段
example_zh: ……岁、……个月等，那个婴儿才出生几个小时。

definition: on somebody’s body; being worn
example: Put your coat on.
definition_zh: 在某人的身上；被穿在身上

definition: in or into a position covering, touching or forming part of a surface
example: a picture on a wall
definition_zh: 处于覆盖、接触或构成某表面一部分的位置

definition: on one occasion only; one time
example: I've only been there once.
definition_zh: 仅此一次；一次

definition: the number 1
example: Do you want one or two?
definition_zh: 数字1

definition: the number 1
example: Do you want one or two?
definition_zh: 数字1

definition: used to avoid repeating a noun, when you are referring to somebody/something that has already been mentioned, or that the person you are speaking to knows about
example: I'd like an ice cream. Are you having one, too?
definition_zh: 用于避免重复名词，当你提到某人或某物时，如果该人或物此前已被提及，或者与你交谈的人已经知道的话
example_zh: 我想吃个冰淇淋。你也要吃吗？

definition: a round vegetable with many layers inside each other and a brown, red or white skin. Onions have a strong smell and taste.
example: Chop the onions finely.
definition_zh: 一种圆形的蔬菜，内部由多层鳞片相互包裹，表皮呈棕色、红色或白色。洋葱气味和味道都很浓烈。

definition: available on or done using the internet or other computer network
example: Online shopping is both cheap and convenient.
definition_zh: 可通过互联网或其他计算机网络访问或使用

definition: onto the internet; using the internet or other computer network
example: Many children would rather go online than watch television.
definition_zh: 接入互联网；使用互联网或其他计算机网络
example_zh: 许多孩子宁愿上网，也不愿看电视。

definition: used to say that no other or others of the same group exist or are there
example: She's their only daughter.
definition_zh: 用于表示不存在其他对象，或者同一组中不存在其他对象

definition: nobody or nothing except
example: There are only a limited number of tickets available.
definition_zh: 除了……之外，没有任何人或任何事物

definition: allowing things or people to go through; not closed or blocked
example: A wasp flew in the open window.
definition_zh: 允许事物或人通过；未关闭或未阻塞
example_zh: 一只黄蜂从敞开的窗户飞了进来。

definition: to move a door, window, lid, etc. into a position that is no longer closed; to get into this position
example: Mr Chen opened the car door for his wife.
definition_zh: 将门、窗、盖子等移至不再处于关闭状态的位置；进入该位置
example_zh: 陈先生为妻子打开了车门。

definition: your feelings or thoughts about somebody/something, rather than a fact
example: He has very strong political opinions.
definition_zh: 你对某人或某事的感受或想法，而非事实
example_zh: 他的政治观点非常鲜明。

definition: on the other side of a particular area from somebody/something and usually facing them
example: Answers are given on the opposite page.
definition_zh: 位于某人/某物所在区域的另一侧，且通常与之相对

definition: on the other side of a particular area from somebody/something and usually facing them
example: There's a newly married couple living opposite (= on the other side of the road).
definition_zh: 位于某人/某物所在区域的另一侧，且通常与之相对
example_zh: 对面（=马路对面）住着一对新婚夫妇。

definition: a person or thing that is as different as possible from somebody/something else
example: Hot and cold are opposites.
definition_zh: 与某人或某物截然不同的人或物

definition: on the other side of a particular area from somebody/something, and usually facing them
example: I sat opposite him during the meal (= on the other side of the table).
definition_zh: 位于某人/某物所在区域的另一侧，且通常与之相对
example_zh: 吃饭时，我坐在他对面（= 桌子的另一边）。

definition: used to introduce another possibility
example: Is your sister older or younger than you?
definition_zh: 用于引入另一种可能性
example_zh: 你姐姐比你大还是比你小？

definition: between red and yellow in colour
example: yellow and orange flames
definition_zh: 颜色介于红色和黄色之间

definition: a round citrus fruit with thick skin of a colour between red and yellow and a lot of sweet juice
example: orange peel/zest/rind
definition_zh: 一种圆形的柑橘类水果，果皮厚，颜色介于红色和黄色之间，汁液丰富且甜美

definition: the way in which people or things are placed or arranged in relation to each other
example: in… order, The names are listed in alphabetical order.
definition_zh: 人或物之间相互位置或排列的方式
example_zh: 按……顺序，这些名字按字母顺序排列。

definition: to ask for something to eat or drink in a restaurant, bar, etc.
example: order (something), I ordered a coffee and a sandwich.
definition_zh: 在餐厅、酒吧等场所点餐或点饮料。
example_zh: 点（某物），我点了一杯咖啡和一个三明治。

definition: used to refer to people or things that are additional or different to people or things that have been mentioned or are known about
example: Mr Harris and Mrs Bate and three other teachers were there.
definition_zh: 用于指代那些与已提及或已知的人或事物相比，属于额外或不同的其他人和事物
example_zh: 哈里斯先生、贝特夫人和另外三位老师都在场。

definition: used to refer to people or things that are additional or different to people or things that have been mentioned or are known about
example: Mr Harris and Mrs Bate and three other teachers were there.
definition_zh: 用于指代那些与已提及或已知的人或事物相比，属于额外或不同的其他人和事物
example_zh: 哈里斯先生、贝特夫人和另外三位老师都在场。

definition: belonging to us; connected with us
example: our daughter/dog/house
definition_zh: 属于我们的；与我们有关的

definition: away from the inside of a place or thing
example: She ran out into the corridor.
definition_zh: 远离某处或某物的内部

definition: away from the inside of a place or thing
example: She ran out into the corridor.
definition_zh: 远离某处或某物的内部

definition: not in a room, building or container but on or to the outside of it
example: I'm seeing a patient—please wait outside.
definition_zh: 不在房间、建筑物或容器内，而是在其上或外部
example_zh: 我正在接诊一位患者——请在外面等一下。

definition: across a street, an open space, etc.
example: I stopped and crossed over.
definition_zh: 穿过一条街道、一片空地等。

definition: resting on the surface of somebody/something and partly or completely covering them/it
example: She put a blanket over the sleeping child.
definition_zh: 停留在某人/某物表面，并部分或完全覆盖住他们/它
example_zh: 她给熟睡的孩子盖上了一条毯子。

definition: used to emphasize that something belongs to or is connected with somebody
example: It was her own idea.
definition_zh: 用于强调某物属于某人或与某人有关

definition: used to emphasize that something belongs to or is connected with somebody
example: It was her own idea.
definition_zh: 用于强调某物属于某人或与某人有关

definition: one side or both sides of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, etc.
example: Turn to page 64.
definition_zh: 书籍、杂志等中的一张纸的一面或两面。

definition: a liquid that is put on surfaces to give them a particular colour; a layer of this liquid when it has dried on a surface
example: white paint
definition_zh: 一种涂在物体表面以使其呈现特定颜色的液体；这种液体在物体表面干燥后形成的薄层

definition: to cover a surface or object with paint
example: paint something with something, Paint the shed with weather-resistant paint.
definition_zh: 用油漆覆盖表面或物体
example_zh: 用某种东西给某物涂漆，用耐候漆给棚屋涂漆。

definition: a picture that has been painted
example: a watercolour/crylic painting
definition_zh: 一幅已经画好的画

definition: two things of the same type, especially when they are used or worn together
example: a pair of shoes/boots
definition_zh: 两件同类物品，尤其是当它们被一起使用或穿着时

definition: the thin material that you write and draw on and that is also used for wrapping and packing things
example: a piece/sheet of paper
definition_zh: 一种薄薄的材料，既可以用来书写和绘画，也可以用来包裹和包装物品

definition: a section of a piece of writing, usually consisting of several sentences dealing with a single subject. The first sentence of a paragraph starts on a new line.
example: an opening/introductory paragraph
definition_zh: 文章中的一段，通常由几句围绕同一主题展开的句子组成。段落的第一句应换行开始。

definition: a person’s father or mother
example: He's still living with his parents.
definition_zh: 某人的父亲或母亲
example_zh: 他现在还和父母住在一起。

definition: an area of public land in a town or a city where people go to walk, play and relax
example: Hyde Park
definition_zh: 城镇中的一片公共用地，人们常去那里散步、玩耍和放松

definition: to leave a vehicle that you are driving in a particular place for a period of time
example: He parked and went inside.
definition_zh: 将自己驾驶的车辆停放在某处一段时间
example_zh: 他把车停好，走进了里面。

definition: some but not all of a thing
example: We spent part of the time in the museum.
definition_zh: 某事的一部分，但并非全部
example_zh: 我们花了一部分时间在博物馆里。

definition: a person that you are doing an activity with, such as dancing or playing a game
example: a dance/tennis partner
definition_zh: 与你一起进行某项活动的人，例如跳舞或玩游戏

definition: a social occasion, often in a person’s home, at which people eat, drink, talk, dance and enjoy themselves
example: a dinner/tea/cocktail party
definition_zh: 一种社交聚会，通常在某人家中举行，人们在聚会上吃喝、交谈、跳舞并尽情享受

definition: an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country, and that you may have to show when you enter or leave a country
example: a valid passport
definition_zh: 一份官方文件，用于证明您是某国公民，您在出入境时可能需要出示该文件

definition: gone by in time
example: in past years/centuries
definition_zh: 随时间流逝
example_zh: 在过去的几年/几个世纪里

definition: the time that has gone by; things that happened in an earlier time
example: in the past, I used to go there often in the past.
definition_zh: 已经流逝的时光；过去发生的事情

definition: later than something
example: half past two
definition_zh: 比……晚

definition: to give somebody money for work, goods, services, etc.
example: Who's paying?
definition_zh: 因工作、商品、服务等向某人支付金钱。

definition: an instrument made of plastic or metal used for writing with ink (= coloured liquid for writing, etc.)
example: an ink pen
definition_zh: 一种由塑料或金属制成的、用于蘸墨水（即用于书写等的有色液体）书写的工具

definition: a narrow piece of wood, or a metal or plastic case, containing a black or coloured substance, used for drawing or writing
example: I'll get a pencil and paper.
definition_zh: 一块细长的木条，或一个金属或塑料笔管，内装黑色或彩色物质，用于绘画或书写
example_zh: 我去拿支铅笔和一张纸。

definition: human beings; men, women and children
example: At least ten people were killed in the crash.
definition_zh: 人类；男人、女人和孩子
example_zh: 这起事故造成至少十人死亡。

definition: a powder made from dried berries (called peppercorns), used to give a hot, spicy taste to food
example: Season with salt and pepper
definition_zh: 一种由干燥的浆果（称为胡椒粒）制成的粉末，用于给食物增添辛辣的味道

definition: having everything that is necessary; complete and without faults or weaknesses
example: in perfect condition
definition_zh: 具备一切必要条件；完整且无缺陷或弱点

definition: a particular length of time
example: a long/an extended period
definition_zh: 一段特定的时间
example_zh: 一段很长的时间/较长的一段时间

definition: a human as an individual
example: What sort of person would do a thing like that?
definition_zh: 作为个体的一个人
example_zh: 什么样的人会干出这种事？

definition: your own; not belonging to or connected with anyone else
example: The novel is written from personal experience.
definition_zh: 属于你自己的；不属于或与任何其他人无关的
example_zh: 这部小说是根据亲身经历写成的。

definition: a piece of equipment for talking to people who are not in the same place as you
example: I have to make a phone call.
definition_zh: 一种用于与不在同一地点的人通话的设备

definition: to make a phone call to somebody
example: I was just phoning up for a chat.
definition_zh: 给某人打个电话
example_zh: 我只是打个电话聊聊天。

definition: a picture that is made by using a camera that stores images in digital form or that has a film sensitive to light inside it
example: a colour/black-and-white photo
definition_zh: 使用相机拍摄的照片，该相机将图像以数字形式存储，或者内部装有感光胶片

definition: a picture that is made by using a camera that stores images in digital form or that has a film sensitive to light inside it
example: aerial photographs of the crash site
definition_zh: 使用相机拍摄的照片，该相机将图像以数字形式存储，或者内部装有感光胶片

definition: a group of words that have a particular meaning when used together
example: a memorable/catchy phrase
definition_zh: 一组词语，当它们组合在一起时具有特定含义
example_zh: 一句令人难忘/朗朗上口的短语

definition: a large musical instrument played by pressing the black and white keys on the keyboard. The sound is produced by small hammers hitting the metal strings inside the piano.
example: to play the piano
definition_zh: 一种大型乐器，演奏时需按下键盘上的黑键和白键。声音是由小锤敲击钢琴内部的金属琴弦产生的。

definition: a painting or drawing, etc. that shows a scene, a person or thing
example: He likes books with lots of pictures in them.
definition_zh: 一幅描绘场景、人物或事物的绘画或素描等
example_zh: 他喜欢里面有很多图片的书。

definition: an amount of something that has been cut or separated from the rest of it; a standard amount of something
example: piece of something, She wrote something on a small piece of paper.
definition_zh: 从整体中切下或分离出来的一定数量；某物的标准份量
example_zh: 某物的碎片，她在一小张纸上写了点什么。

definition: an animal with pink, black or brown skin, short legs, a broad nose and a short curly tail. Pigs are kept on farms for their meat (called pork) or live in the wild.
example: a pig farmer
definition_zh: 一种皮肤呈粉色、黑色或棕色，四肢短小，鼻部宽大，尾巴短而卷曲的动物。猪有的被饲养在农场以获取肉类（称为猪肉），有的则生活在野外。

definition: pale red in colour
example: pale pink roses
definition_zh: 呈淡红色

definition: the colour that is produced when you mix red and white together
example: She was dressed in pink.
definition_zh: 将红色和白色混合后产生的颜色
example_zh: 她穿了一身粉色的衣服。

definition: a particular position, point or area
example: in a place, Keep your purse in a safe place.
definition_zh: 某个位置、点或区域
example_zh: 在某处，请将钱包放在安全的地方。

definition: something that you intend to do or achieve
example: plan for something, Do you have any plans for the summer?
definition_zh: 你打算做或实现的事情
example_zh: 计划做点什么，你对这个夏天有什么计划吗？

definition: to make detailed arrangements for something you want to do in the future
example: plan something, to plan a trip
definition_zh: 为将来想做的事情制定详细计划
example_zh: 计划某事，计划一次旅行

definition: a flying vehicle with wings and one or more engines
example: a passenger/fighter/military/private plane
definition_zh: 一种带有机翼和一个或多个发动机的飞行器
example_zh: 客机/战斗机/军用飞机/私人飞机

definition: a living thing that grows in the earth and usually has a stem, leaves and roots, especially one that is smaller than a tree or bush
example: All plants need light and water.
definition_zh: 生长在土壤中的生物，通常具有茎、叶和根，尤其是比树或灌木更小的那种
example_zh: 所有植物都需要光和水。

definition: a piece of writing performed by actors in a theatre or on television or radio
example: a stage/radio play
definition_zh: 由演员在剧院、电视或广播中演绎的一部作品

definition: to do things for pleasure, as children do; to enjoy yourself, rather than work
example: You'll have to play inside today.
definition_zh: 像孩子一样，为了乐趣而做事；享受生活，而不是工作
example_zh: 今天你们得在室内玩了。

definition: a person who takes part in a game or sport
example: a football/tennis/chess player
definition_zh: 参加比赛或体育运动的人
example_zh: 一名足球/网球/国际象棋运动员

definition: used as a polite way of asking for something or telling somebody to do something
example: Please sit down.
definition_zh: 用作礼貌地提出请求或请人做某事的表达方式

definition: a thing that somebody says or writes giving their opinion or stating a fact
example: She made several interesting points in the article.
definition_zh: 某人说或写下的、表达其观点或陈述事实的内容
example_zh: 她在文章中提出了一些有趣的观点。

definition: an official organization whose job is to make people obey the law and to prevent and solve crime; the people who work for this organization
example: Get out of the house or I'll call the police.
definition_zh: 一个官方机构，其职责是确保人们遵守法律，并预防和解决犯罪；该机构的工作人员
example_zh: 赶紧离开这房子，否则我就报警。

definition: a male police officer
example: a plain-clothes/uniformed policeman
definition_zh: 一名男警官

definition: an area of water that has been created for people to swim in
example: an indoor/outdoor pool
definition_zh: 为供人们游泳而开辟的水域

definition: having very little money; not having enough money for basic needs
example: They were too poor to buy shoes for the kids.
definition_zh: 手头非常拮据；连基本生活所需都难以维持
example_zh: 他们太穷了，买不起孩子的鞋子。

definition: liked or enjoyed by a large number of people
example: Andalucia is a popular tourist destination.
definition_zh: 受到大量人群的喜爱或欣赏
example_zh: 安达卢西亚是一个备受游客青睐的旅游胜地。

definition: good or useful
example: The tests have so far yielded positive results.
definition_zh: 好或有用
example_zh: 到目前为止，这些测试已取得积极成果。

definition: that can be done or achieved
example: possible to do something, New technology has made it possible to communicate more easily.
definition_zh: 可以做到或实现的
example_zh: 做某件事是可能的，新技术使得沟通变得更加容易。

definition: the official system used for sending and delivering letters, packages, etc.
example: by post, I'll send the original to you by post.
definition_zh: 用于寄送和投递信件、包裹等的官方系统。
example_zh: 通过邮寄，我会把原件寄给您。

definition: to send a letter, etc. to somebody by post
example: post something, The cost of posting a letter has gone up again.
definition_zh: 通过邮寄方式给某人寄一封信等
example_zh: 寄点东西，寄信的费用又涨了。

definition: a round white vegetable with a brown or red skin that grows underground as part of a plant also called a potato
example: Will you peel the potatoes for me?
definition_zh: 一种圆形的白色蔬菜，表皮呈棕色或红色，生长在地下，是某种植物的一部分，也被称为土豆
example_zh: 你能帮我把土豆削皮吗？

definition: the unit of money in the UK, worth 100 pence
example: a ten-pound note
definition_zh: 英国的货币单位，相当于100便士

definition: doing an activity or training regularly so that you can improve your skill; the time you spend doing this
example: conversation practice
definition_zh: 定期进行某项活动或训练，以提高自己的技能；用于此活动的时间

definition: to do an activity or train regularly so that you can improve your skill
example: You need to practise every day.
definition_zh: 定期参加某项活动或进行训练，以便提高自己的技能

definition: to like one thing or person better than another; to choose one thing rather than something else because you like it better
example: prefer something, ‘Coffee or tea?’ ‘I'd prefer tea, thanks.’
definition_zh: 比另一件事或另一个人更喜欢某件事或某个人；因为更喜欢某件事，所以选择它而不是其他事情
example_zh: 更喜欢某样东西，“咖啡还是茶？”“我更喜欢茶，谢谢。”

definition: to make something or somebody ready to be used or to do something
example: prepare something/somebody, to prepare a report
definition_zh: 使某物或某人做好准备，以便使用或做某事
example_zh: 准备某事/某人，准备一份报告

definition: existing or happening now
example: I am not satisfied with the present situation.
definition_zh: 现有的或正在发生的
example_zh: 我对目前的状况并不满意。

definition: a thing that you give to somebody as a gift
example: What can I get him for a birthday present?
definition_zh: 送给某人的礼物
example_zh: 我该给他买什么生日礼物呢？

definition: attractive without being very beautiful
example: a pretty face
definition_zh: 虽不算特别漂亮，但很有魅力

definition: to some extent; fairly
example: The game was pretty good.
definition_zh: 在某种程度上；相当

definition: the amount of money that you have to pay for something
example: Boat for sale, price £8 000
definition_zh: 为某件事需要支付的金额
example_zh: 船只出售，售价 8 000 英镑

definition: used to say that something is likely to happen or to be true
example: You're probably right.
definition_zh: 常用来表示某事很可能发生或属实

definition: a thing that is difficult to deal with or to understand
example: big/serious/major problems
definition_zh: 难以应对或难以理解的事情

definition: a thing that is grown, produced or created, usually for sale
example: food/agricultural/software products
definition_zh: 指通常为销售目的而种植、生产或制造的物品

definition: something that people watch on television or listen to on the radio
example: a news programme
definition_zh: 人们在电视上观看或在广播中收听的内容

definition: a piece of work involving careful study of a subject over a period of time, done by school or college students
example: a history project
definition_zh: 指中小学生或大学生在一段时间内对某一课题进行深入研究后完成的一篇作业

definition: having the colour of blue and red mixed together
example: a purple flower/dress
definition_zh: 由蓝色和红色混合而成的颜色
example_zh: 一朵紫色的花/一条紫色的连衣裙

definition: the colour of blue and red mixed together
example: Her hair was dyed a bright shade of purple.
definition_zh: 蓝色和红色混合后的颜色
example_zh: 她的头发染成了鲜艳的紫色。

definition: to move something into a particular place or position
example: Put the cases down there, please.
definition_zh: 将某物移至特定位置或地点

definition: one of four equal parts of something
example: quarter of something, a quarter of an hour/a century
definition_zh: 某物的四个等分之一
example_zh: 某物的四分之一，一刻钟/一个世纪

definition: a sentence, phrase or word that asks for information
example: You didn't answer my question.
definition_zh: 用于询问信息的句子、短语或单词

definition: done with speed; taking or lasting a short time
example: a quick look/check/search
definition_zh: 迅速完成；耗时短暂或持续时间短

definition: fast
example: She walked quickly away.
definition_zh: 快

definition: making very little noise
example: her quiet voice
definition_zh: 几乎没有声音

definition: to some degree
example: quite good/interesting/common/difficult
definition_zh: 在某种程度上
example_zh: 相当不错/很有趣/很常见/很难

definition: the activity of broadcasting programmes for people to listen to; the programmes that are broadcast
example: The play was written specially for radio.
definition_zh: 向公众广播节目供人们收听的活动；所播出的节目
example_zh: 这部戏剧是专门为广播创作的。

definition: water that falls from the sky in separate drops
example: There will be rain in all parts tomorrow.
definition_zh: 从天上以单独的水滴形式落下的水

definition: when it rains, water falls from the sky in drops
example: Is it raining?
definition_zh: 下雨时，水会一滴一滴地从天上落下

definition: to look at and understand the meaning of written or printed words or symbols
example: She's still learning to read.
definition_zh: 观察并理解书面或印刷文字或符号的含义

definition: a person who reads, especially one who reads a lot or in a particular way
example: an avid reader of science fiction
definition_zh: 指喜欢阅读的人，尤其是阅读量很大或以某种特定方式阅读的人
example_zh: 一位科幻小说的狂热爱好者

definition: the activity of somebody who reads
example: My hobbies include reading and painting.
definition_zh: 某人阅读时的活动
example_zh: 我的爱好包括阅读和绘画。

definition: fully prepared for what you are going to do and able to start it immediately
example: Just a minute—I'm almost ready.
definition_zh: 对即将要做的事情做好了充分准备，能够立即着手进行

definition: actually existing or happening and not imagined or pretended
example: a real danger/risk/threat/concern
definition_zh: 确实存在或正在发生，而非虚构或假装的
example_zh: 真正的危险/风险/威胁/担忧

definition: used to emphasize an adjective or adverb
example: That's a really good idea.
definition_zh: 用于强调形容词或副词

definition: a cause or an explanation for something that has happened or that somebody has done
example: He said no but he didn't give a reason.
definition_zh: 某件事发生或某人做某事的原因或解释
example_zh: 他说“不”，但没有说明原因。

definition: having the colour of blood or fire
example: bright/light/dark red lipstick
definition_zh: 呈血色或火红色
example_zh: 亮红色/浅红色/深红色口红

definition: the colour of blood or fire
example: She often wears red.
definition_zh: 血色或火色

definition: to rest while you are doing something that you enjoy, especially after work or effort
example: Just relax and enjoy the movie.
definition_zh: 在做自己喜欢的事情时放松一下，尤其是在工作或劳累之后
example_zh: 放松一下，好好享受这部电影吧。

definition: to have or keep an image in your memory of an event, a person, a place, etc. from the past
example: remember somebody/something, This is Carla. Do you remember her?
definition_zh: 在记忆中保留对过去某件事、某个人、某个地方等的印象
example_zh: 记得某人/某事吗？这是卡拉。你还记得她吗？

definition: to say or write something again or more than once
example: repeat something, to repeat a question/a claim/an assertion/a warning
definition_zh: 再次或多次说或写某事
example_zh: 重复某事，重复一个问题/一个说法/一个断言/一个警告

definition: a written or spoken account of an event, especially one that is published or broadcast
example: Are these news reports true?
definition_zh: 对某事件的书面或口头叙述，尤其是已发表或播出的叙述
example_zh: 这些新闻报道是真的吗？

definition: a place where you can buy and eat a meal
example: We're going to try this Italian restaurant that just opened.
definition_zh: 一个既能买饭又能用餐的地方
example_zh: 我们打算去那家刚开业的意大利餐厅尝尝。

definition: a thing that is caused or produced because of something else
example: And did your intervention produce the desired result?
definition_zh: 因某事而引起或产生的结果
example_zh: 那么，你的干预是否达到了预期的效果？

definition: the action of arriving in or coming back to a place that you were in before
example: return of somebody to…, A week had passed since their return to Geneva.
definition_zh: 抵达或返回你之前曾去过的地方这一行为
example_zh: 某人返回……，他们回到日内瓦已经一周了。

definition: to come or go back from one place to another
example: I waited a long time for him to return.
definition_zh: 从一个地方前往另一个地方，或从一个地方返回另一个地方
example_zh: 我等了他很久，就等着他回来。

definition: short, narrow white or brown grain grown on wet land in hot countries as food; the plant that produces this grain
example: a grain of rice
definition_zh: 一种短而细的白色或棕色谷物，生长在热带国家的湿地中，作为食物；能产出这种谷物的植物

definition: having a lot of money or property
example: She's one of the richest women in the world.
definition_zh: 拥有大量金钱或财产
example_zh: 她是世界上最富有的女性之一。

definition: to sit on an animal, especially a horse, and control it as it moves
example: I learnt to ride as a child.
definition_zh: 骑在动物身上，尤其是马身上，并在其行进时加以控制

definition: true or correct as a fact
example: Did you get the answer right?
definition_zh: 作为事实而言是真实的或正确的

definition: on or to the right side
example: Turn right at the end of the street.
definition_zh: 在……上或右侧
example_zh: 走到街道尽头后向右转。

definition: the right side or direction
example: on the right, Take the first street on the right.
definition_zh: 右侧或方向
example_zh: 在右侧，沿第一条右转的街道前行。

definition: a natural flow of water that continues in a long line across land to the sea
example: Eventually we came to the mouth of the River Thames.
definition_zh: 一条自然的水流，沿着陆地绵延不绝，最终汇入大海
example_zh: 最终，我们来到了泰晤士河的河口。

definition: a hard surface built for vehicles to travel on
example: a main/major/minor road
definition_zh: 专为车辆通行而建造的坚硬路面
example_zh: 主干道/主要道路/次要道路

definition: a part of a building that has its own walls, floor and ceiling and is usually used for a particular purpose
example: I heard him enter the room.
definition_zh: 建筑物中拥有独立墙壁、地板和天花板，通常用于特定用途的部分

definition: the normal order and way in which you regularly do things
example: to settle/get/fall into a routine
definition_zh: 你平时做事的一贯顺序和方式
example_zh: 进入/养成/形成一种常规

definition: a statement of what may, must or must not be done in a particular situation or when playing a game
example: She laid down strict rules for her tenants, including prompt payment of rent.
definition_zh: 关于在特定情况下或进行游戏时，哪些行为可以、必须或不得采取的说明
example_zh: 她为租客制定了严格的规则，其中包括必须按时缴纳房租。

definition: to move using your legs, going faster than when you walk
example: Can you run as fast as Mike?
definition_zh: 用双腿移动，速度比走路快
example_zh: 你能跑得像迈克一样快吗？

definition: unhappy or showing unhappiness
example: sad to do something, We are very sad to hear that you are leaving.
definition_zh: 不高兴或表现出不高兴
example_zh: 做某事感到难过，得知你要离开，我们感到非常难过。

definition: a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, tomato and cucumber, usually served with other food as part of a meal
example: All main courses come with salad or vegetables.
definition_zh: 由生蔬菜（如生菜、番茄和黄瓜）混合而成的菜肴，通常作为正餐的一部分与其他食物一同食用
example_zh: 所有主菜均配有沙拉或蔬菜。

definition: a white substance that is added to food to make it taste better or to preserve it. Salt is obtained from mines and is also found in seawater. It is sometimes called common salt to show that it is different from other chemical salts. Its chemical name is sodium chloride.
example: Pass the salt, please.
definition_zh: 一种白色物质，添加到食物中以改善口味或延长保质期。盐采自矿山，也存在于海水中。它有时被称为“食盐”，以表明其与其他化学盐不同。其化学名称为氯化钠。

definition: exactly the one or ones referred to or mentioned; not different
example: We have lived in the same house for twenty years.
definition_zh: 正是所指或提及的那个或那些；并非其他
example_zh: 我们在这栋房子里住了二十年。

definition: in the same way
example: We treat boys exactly the same as girls.
definition_zh: 同样地
example_zh: 我们对待男孩和女孩完全一样。

definition: the same thing or things
example: I would do the same again.
definition_zh: 同一件事或几件事
example_zh: 如果再遇到同样的情况，我还会这么做。

definition: two slices of bread, often spread with butter, with a layer of meat, cheese, etc. between them
example: a ham/tuna/egg sandwich
definition_zh: 两片面包，通常涂上黄油，中间夹着一层肉、奶酪等
example_zh: 火腿/金枪鱼/鸡蛋三明治

definition: the day of the week after Friday and before Sunday
example: It's Saturday today, isn't it?
definition_zh: 周五之后、周日之前的那个星期几

definition: to speak or tell somebody something, using words
example: + speech, ‘Hello!’ she said.
definition_zh: 用语言向某人表达或讲述某事

definition: a place where children go to be educated
example: My brother and I went to the same school.
definition_zh: 孩子们去接受教育的地方
example_zh: 我和我哥哥上的是同一所学校。

definition: knowledge about the structure and behaviour of the natural and physical world, based on facts that you can prove, for example by experiments
example: new developments in science and technology
definition_zh: 基于可证实的事实（例如通过实验）所获得的关于自然界和物理世界结构与行为的知识

definition: a person who studies one or more of the natural sciences (= for example, physics, chemistry or biology)
example: a research scientist
definition_zh: 研究一项或多项自然科学（例如物理学、化学或生物学）的人

definition: the salt water that covers most of the earth’s surface and surrounds its continents and islands
example: The waste was dumped in the sea.
definition_zh: 覆盖地球大部分地表、环绕各大洲和岛屿的咸水
example_zh: 这些垃圾被倾倒进了大海。

definition: happening or coming next after the first in a series of similar things or people; 2nd
example: This is the second time it's happened.
definition_zh: 在一系列相似的事物或人中，紧随其后发生或出现的；第二
example_zh: 这是第二次发生这种情况了。

definition: a unit for measuring time. There are 60 seconds in one minute.
example: in… seconds, She can run 100 metres in just over 11 seconds.
definition_zh: 一种时间单位。一分钟有60秒。
example_zh: ……秒内，她跑完100米只需11秒多一点。

definition: happening or coming next after the first in a series of similar things or people; 2nd
example: This is the second time it's happened.
definition_zh: 在一系列相似的事物或人中，紧随其后发生或出现的；第二
example_zh: 这是第二次发生这种情况了。

definition: any of the parts into which something is divided
example: section of something, That section of the road is still closed.
definition_zh: 某物被划分为的任何部分
example_zh: 某事物的某一段，那段路仍然封闭。

definition: to become aware of somebody/something by using your eyes
example: see somebody/something, She looked for him but couldn't see him in the crowd.
definition_zh: 通过眼睛注意到某人或某物
example_zh: 看到某人/某物，她四处寻找他，却没能在人群中找到他。

definition: to give something to somebody in exchange for money
example: sell (something), I recently sold my bike.
definition_zh: 为了换取金钱而给某人某物
example_zh: 卖（某物），我最近卖掉了我的自行车。

definition: to make something go or be taken to a place, especially by post, email, radio, etc.
example: send something, She sent a letter of support.
definition_zh: 使某物送达或被送往某地，尤其是通过邮寄、电子邮件、广播等方式。I.
example_zh: 寄点东西，她寄了一封支持信。

definition: a set of words expressing a statement, a question or an order, usually containing a subject and a verb. In written English sentences begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop/period (.), a question mark (?) or an exclamation mark (!).
example: Does the sentence contain an adverb?
definition_zh: 由若干词语组成的表达陈述、疑问或命令的语句，通常包含主语和谓语。在书面英语中，句子以大写字母开头，以句号（.）、问号（?）或感叹号（!）结尾。

definition: the 9th month of the year, between August and October
example: She was born in September.
definition_zh: 该年的第9个月，介于8月和10月之间

example: There are seven cookies left.

definition: the number 17
example: She is seventeen years old.
definition_zh: 数字17

definition: the number 70
example: More than seventy people attended the meeting.
definition_zh: 数字70
example_zh: 有七十多人参加了这次会议。

definition: to have, use or experience something at the same time as somebody else
example: There isn't an empty table. Would you mind sharing?
definition_zh: 与某人同时拥有、使用或体验某物
example_zh: 这里没有空桌子。方便和我共用一张桌子吗？

definition: a female person or animal that has already been mentioned or is easily identified
example: ‘What does your sister do?’ ‘She's a dentist.’
definition_zh: 指已经提过或很容易辨认的女性或动物
example_zh: “你姐姐是做什么的？”“她是牙医。”

definition: an animal with a thick coat, kept on farms for its meat (called mutton or lamb) or its wool
example: a flock of sheep
definition_zh: 一种毛发浓密的动物，在农场中饲养，以获取其肉（称为羊肉或羔羊肉）或羊毛

definition: a piece of clothing worn on the upper part of the body, made of light cloth, with sleeves and usually with a collar and buttons down the front
example: to wear a shirt
definition_zh: 一种穿在上半身的衣物，由轻薄的布料制成，带有袖子，通常配有领子，正面有纽扣

definition: one of a pair of objects usually made of leather or plastic that you wear on your feet
example: a pair of shoes
definition_zh: 通常由皮革或塑料制成、成对佩戴在脚上的物品之一

definition: a building or part of a building where you can buy goods or services
example: to open/close/run a shop
definition_zh: 可以购买商品或服务的建筑物或建筑物的一部分

definition: to buy things in shops
example: I shop there from time to time.
definition_zh: 在商店里买东西
example_zh: 我时不时会在那儿购物。

definition: the activity of going to shops and buying things or ordering them online
example: to go shopping
definition_zh: 去商店购物或在线下单的行为

definition: measuring or covering a small length or distance, or a smaller length or distance than usual
example: He had short curly hair.
definition_zh: 测量或涵盖较短的长度或距离，或比通常更短的长度或距离

definition: used to show what is right, appropriate, etc., especially when criticizing somebody’s actions
example: You shouldn't drink and drive.
definition_zh: 用于表明什么是正确的、恰当的等，尤其是在批评某人的行为时

definition: a programme on television or the radio
example: Millions of people watch the show.
definition_zh: 电视或广播节目
example_zh: 有数百万观众收看这档节目。

definition: to make something clear; to prove something
example: show (that)…, The figures clearly show that her claims are false.
definition_zh: 阐明某事；证明某事
example_zh: 表明（……），这些数据清楚地表明她的说法是错误的。

definition: a piece of equipment producing a flow of water that you stand under to wash yourself; the small room or part of a room that contains a shower
example: in the shower, He's in the shower.
definition_zh: 一种能产生水流的设备，人们站在水流下冲洗身体；设有淋浴设施的小房间或房间的一部分
example_zh: 在淋浴间里，他在淋浴间里。

definition: physically or mentally ill
example: a sick child
definition_zh: 患有身体或精神疾病

definition: like somebody/something but not exactly the same
example: We have very similar interests.
definition_zh: 像某人/某物，但又不完全一样

definition: to make musical sounds with your voice in the form of a song or tune
example: I just can't sing in tune!
definition_zh: 用嗓音发出音乐声，以歌曲或旋律的形式呈现

definition: a person who sings, or whose job is singing, especially in public
example: She's a wonderful singer.
definition_zh: 指唱歌的人，或以唱歌为职业的人，尤其是在公众场合唱歌的人

definition: a girl or woman who has the same mother and father as another person
example: She's my sister.
definition_zh: 与另一个人父母相同的女孩或妇女

definition: to rest your weight on your bottom with your back straight, for example on/in a chair
example: She sat and stared at the letter in front of her.
definition_zh: 将身体重量放在臀部上，保持背部挺直，例如坐在椅子上
example_zh: 她坐在那里，盯着眼前的信。

definition: all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place
example: the present economic/financial/political situation
definition_zh: 在特定时间和特定地点发生的所有情况和事物
example_zh: 当前的经济、金融和政治形势

example: There are six cookies left.

definition: the number 16
example: He started learning English at sixteen.
definition_zh: 数字16

definition: the number 60
example: There are sixty minutes in an hour.
definition_zh: 数字60

definition: the ability to do something well
example: The job requires skill and an eye for detail.
definition_zh: 把某件事做得很好的能力
example_zh: 这份工作需要技巧和对细节的敏锐观察力。

definition: a piece of clothing that hangs from the middle part of the body
example: a short/long/pleated/denim skirt
definition_zh: 一件从身体中部垂下来的衣物
example_zh: 短裙/长裙/百褶裙/牛仔裙

definition: to rest with your eyes closed and your mind and body not active
example: Let her sleep—it'll do her good.
definition_zh: 闭上眼睛休息，让身心都处于静止状态
example_zh: 让她睡会儿吧——这对她有好处。

definition: not moving, acting or done quickly; taking a long time; not fast
example: a slow pace/speed
definition_zh: 不移动、不行动或不迅速；耗时较长；不快

definition: not large in size, number, degree, amount, etc.
example: a small town/village/community
definition_zh: 在大小、数量、程度、数量等方面都不大。

definition: a reptile with a very long thin body and no legs. There are many types of snake, some of which are poisonous.
example: a snake coiled up in the grass
definition_zh: 一种身体非常细长、没有腿的爬行动物。蛇的种类繁多，其中有些是有毒的。
example_zh: 一条盘踞在草丛中的蛇

definition: small soft white pieces (called flakes) of frozen water that fall from the sky in cold weather; this substance when it is lying on the ground
example: Snow was falling heavily.
definition_zh: 寒冷天气里从天上飘落的小块柔软的白色冰晶（称为“雪片”）；这种物质落在地上时

definition: when it snows, snow falls from the sky
example: It's been snowing heavily all day.
definition_zh: 下雪时，雪从天上飘落
example_zh: 今天一整天都在下大雪。

definition: to such a great degree
example: Don't look so angry.
definition_zh: 如此之大
example_zh: 别摆出那么生气的样子。

definition: used to show the reason for something
example: It was still painful, so I went to see a doctor.
definition_zh: 用于说明某事的原因
example_zh: 因为还是很痛，所以我去看医生了。

definition: used with uncountable nouns or plural countable nouns to mean ‘an amount of’ or ‘a number of’, when the amount or number is not given
example: There's some milk in the fridge.
definition_zh: 用于不可数名词或复数可数名词，表示“一定数量的”或“若干”，当数量未明确指明时

definition: used to refer to an amount of something or a number of people or things when the amount or number is not given
example: Some disapprove of the idea.
definition_zh: 用于指代某物的数量或某人某物的数量，而该数量并未明确说明时
example_zh: 有些人不赞同这个想法。

definition: a person who is not known or mentioned by name
example: Somebody should have told me.
definition_zh: 一个身份不明或未被点名的人

definition: a person who is not known or mentioned by name
example: There's someone at the door.
definition_zh: 一个身份不明或未被点名的人

definition: a thing that is not known or mentioned by name
example: We stopped for something to eat.
definition_zh: 一种未被知晓或未被明确指出的事物

definition: occasionally rather than all of the time
example: Sometimes I go by car.
definition_zh: 偶尔，而不是一直

definition: a person’s male child
example: their four-year-old son
definition_zh: 某人的儿子

definition: a short piece of music with words that you sing
example: a love/pop/rock song
definition_zh: 一段带有歌词的短小乐曲，供你演唱
example_zh: 一首爱情/流行/摇滚歌曲

definition: in a short time from now; a short time after something else has happened
example: She sold the house soon after her husband died.
definition_zh: 从现在起不久之后；在另一件事发生后不久
example_zh: 丈夫去世后不久，她就把房子卖了。

definition: feeling sad and ashamed about something that has been done
example: sorry about something, We're very sorry about the damage to your car.
definition_zh: 因已发生的事情而感到难过和羞愧
example_zh: 关于某事，我们深表歉意。对于您的车辆受损，我们深表歉意。

definition: used when you are apologizing for something
example: Sorry I'm late!
definition_zh: 用于为某事道歉时

definition: something that you can hear
example: a loud/soft/faint sound
definition_zh: 你能听到的东西

definition: to give a particular impression when heard or read about
example: + adj., to sound good/great/right/interesting
definition_zh: 在听闻或读到相关内容时给人一种特定的印象
example_zh: + 形容词，听起来不错/很好/恰当/有趣

definition: a liquid food made by boiling meat, vegetables, etc. in water, often eaten as the first course of a meal
example: a bowl/cup of soup
definition_zh: 一种将肉、蔬菜等食材放入水中煮制而成的汤类食物，通常作为一餐中的第一道菜

definition: in or towards the south
example: South Wales
definition_zh: 在南方或朝向南方

definition: towards the south
example: This room faces south.
definition_zh: 向南

definition: the direction that is on your right when you watch the sun rise; one of the four main points of the compass
example: Which way is south?
definition_zh: 观看日出时位于你右侧的方向；罗盘四大方位之一

definition: the area outside the earth’s atmosphere where all the other planets and stars are
example: in space, Valentina Tereshkova was the first woman in space.
definition_zh: 地球大气层之外的区域，那里有其他所有的行星和恒星
example_zh: 在太空领域，瓦伦蒂娜·捷列什科娃是首位进入太空的女性。

definition: to talk to somebody about something; to have a conversation with somebody
example: speak to somebody, The President refused to speak to reporters.
definition_zh: 与某人谈论某事；与某人交谈
example_zh: 与某人交谈，总统拒绝接受记者采访。

definition: not ordinary or usual; different from what is normal
example: The school will only allow this in special circumstances.
definition_zh: 不寻常或不寻常的；与正常情况不同
example_zh: 学校仅在特殊情况下才会允许这样做。

definition: to say or write the letters of a word in the correct order
example: How do you spell your surname?
definition_zh: 按正确顺序说出或写出一个单词的字母

definition: the act of forming words correctly from individual letters; the ability to do this
example: the differences between British and American spelling
definition_zh: 将单个字母正确组合成单词的行为；这种能力
example_zh: 英式拼写与美式拼写的区别

definition: to give money to pay for goods, services, etc.
example: spend something, I've spent all my money already.
definition_zh: 为购买商品、服务等支付款项。
example_zh: 花点钱？我已经把钱都花光了。

definition: activity that you do for pleasure and that needs physical effort or skill, usually done in a special area and according to fixed rules
example: There are excellent facilities for sport and recreation.
definition_zh: 一种出于娱乐目的、需要体力或技巧的活动，通常在特定场所进行，并遵循固定的规则
example_zh: 这里拥有一流的体育和休闲设施。

definition: the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow
example: The following spring, the three artists travelled to California.
definition_zh: 介于冬季和夏季之间的季节，此时植物开始生长
example_zh: 第二年春天，这三位艺术家前往加利福尼亚。

definition: to be on your feet; to be in a vertical position
example: She was too weak to stand.
definition_zh: 站着；保持直立姿势
example_zh: 她虚弱得连站都站不起来。

definition: a large ball of burning gas in space that we see as a point of light in the sky at night
example: There was a big moon and hundreds of stars were shining overhead.
definition_zh: 太空中一个巨大的燃烧气体球体，我们在夜空中将其视为一个光点
example_zh: 头顶上，一轮圆月高悬，数百颗星星熠熠生辉。

definition: to begin doing or using something
example: start (something), I start work at nine.
definition_zh: 开始做或使用某物
example_zh: 开始（某事），我九点开始工作。

definition: something that you say or write that gives information or an opinion
example: Are the following statements true or false?
definition_zh: 你所说或所写的内容，其中包含信息或观点

definition: a place where trains stop so that passengers can get on and off; the buildings connected with this
example: the main station
definition_zh: 火车停靠以便乘客上下车的地方；与此相关的建筑物

definition: to continue to be in a particular place for a period of time without moving away
example: + adv./prep., Stay there and don't move!
definition_zh: 在一段时间内继续留在某个地方，不离开
example_zh: + 副词/介词，待在那里，别动！

definition: continuing until a particular point in time and not finishing
example: I am very happy that you all are still alive and well.
definition_zh: 持续到某个特定时间点，但尚未结束
example_zh: 我很高兴大家还都活着，而且一切安好。

definition: a place where a bus or train stops regularly for passengers to get on or off
example: I get off at the next stop.
definition_zh: 公交车或火车定期停靠，供乘客上下车的地方

definition: to no longer move; to make somebody/something no longer move
example: The car stopped at the traffic lights.
definition_zh: 不再移动；使某人/某物不再移动
example_zh: 汽车在红绿灯前停了下来。

definition: a description of events and people that the writer or speaker has invented in order to entertain people
example: a tragic love story
definition_zh: 对事件和人物的描述，这些事件和人物是由作者或说话者虚构出来的，旨在娱乐大众

definition: a public road in a city or town that has houses and buildings on one side or both sides
example: along/down/up the street, I was just walking along the street when it happened.
definition_zh: 城市或城镇中，一侧或两侧有房屋和建筑物的公共道路
example_zh: 沿着/顺着/沿着街道走，当时我正沿着街道走着，事情就发生了。

definition: having a lot of physical power so that you can lift heavy weights, do hard physical work, etc.
example: He's strong enough to lift a car!
definition_zh: 拥有很强的体力，从而能够举起重物、从事繁重的体力劳动等。
example_zh: 他力大得连一辆车都能举起来！

definition: a person who is studying at a university or college
example: a college/university student
definition_zh: 在大学或学院就读的人

definition: the activity of learning or gaining knowledge, either from books or by examining things in the world
example: a room set aside for private study
definition_zh: 通过阅读书籍或观察世间万物来学习或获取知识的活动
example_zh: 一间专门用于私人学习的房间

definition: to spend time learning about a subject by reading, going to college, etc.
example: He sat up very late that night, studying.
definition_zh: 通过阅读、上大学等方式，花时间学习某个学科。
example_zh: 那天晚上，他熬夜到很晚，还在学习。

definition: the particular way in which something is done
example: a wide range of musical styles
definition_zh: 做某事的一种特定方式

definition: a thing or person that is being discussed, described or dealt with
example: subject of something, Walker's work has been the subject of much debate.
definition_zh: 正在讨论、描述或处理的事物或人
example_zh: 作为某事的焦点，沃克的作品一直备受争议。

definition: the fact that you have achieved something that you want and have been trying to do or get
example: The company has achieved considerable success in this market.
definition_zh: 你已经实现了自己一直努力尝试去做或获得的某件事这一事实
example_zh: 该公司在这个市场上取得了相当大的成功。

definition: a sweet substance, often in the form of white or brown crystals, made from the juices of various plants, used in cooking or to make tea, coffee, etc. sweeter
example: Do you take sugar (= have it in your tea, coffee, etc.)?
definition_zh: 一种甜味物质，通常呈白色或棕色晶体状，由各种植物的汁液制成，用于烹饪或使茶、咖啡等更甜。
example_zh: 你加糖吗（即在茶、咖啡等饮料里加糖）？

definition: the warmest season of the year, coming between spring and autumn
example: in the summer, We're going away in the summer.
definition_zh: 一年中最温暖的季节，介于春季和秋季之间
example_zh: 夏天，我们夏天要出去玩。

definition: the star that shines in the sky during the day and gives the earth heat and light
example: The sun was shining and birds were singing.
definition_zh: 那颗白天在天空中闪耀、为地球带来热量和光明的星星

definition: the day of the week after Saturday and before Monday, thought of as either the first or the last day of the week
example: It's Sunday today, isn't it?
definition_zh: 星期六之后、星期一之前的那一天，被视为一周的第一天或最后一天

definition: a large shop that sells food, drinks and goods used in the home. People choose what they want from the shelves and pay for it as they leave.
example: I only shop at this supermarket.
definition_zh: 一家大型商店，出售食品、饮料和日用品。顾客从货架上挑选所需商品，离开时付款。

definition: confident that you know something or that you are right
example: ‘Is that John over there?’ ‘I'm not sure’.
definition_zh: 确信自己知道某些事情，或者确信自己是正确的

definition: a piece of clothing for the upper part of the body, made of wool or cotton, with long sleeves
example: She wore jeans and a sweater.
definition_zh: 一种由羊毛或棉制成的、带有长袖的上身衣物

definition: to move through water by moving your arms and legs, without touching the bottom
example: I can't swim.
definition_zh: 通过摆动胳膊和腿在水中前进，而不触底

definition: the sport or activity of swimming
example: Swimming is a good form of exercise.
definition_zh: 游泳这项运动或活动
example_zh: 游泳是一种很好的锻炼方式。

definition: an informal shirt, usually with short sleeves (= arms) no collar or buttons, or just a few buttons at the top
example: He was wearing a faded pair of blue jeans and an old T-shirt.
definition_zh: 一种休闲衬衫，通常为短袖（即袖子较短），无领且无纽扣，或者仅在领口处有几颗纽扣
example_zh: 他穿着一条褪色的蓝色牛仔裤和一件旧T恤。

definition: a piece of furniture that consists of a flat top supported by legs
example: at a/the table, We sat at a round table in the corner.
definition_zh: 一种由平坦的台面和支撑台面的腿组成的家具
example_zh: 在桌子旁，我们坐在一张位于角落的圆桌旁。

definition: to carry or move something from one place to another
example: take something, Remember to take your coat when you leave.
definition_zh: 将某物从一处搬运或移动到另一处
example_zh: 带上某样东西，离开时记得带上外套。

definition: to say things; to speak in order to give information or to express feelings, ideas, etc.
example: Stop talking and listen!
definition_zh: 说话；为了传达信息或表达情感、想法等而开口说话。

definition: having a greater than average height
example: She's tall and thin.
definition_zh: 身高高于平均水平

definition: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere. Taxis usually have meters that show how much money you have to pay.
example: We took a taxi to the airport.
definition_zh: 一辆由司机驾驶的汽车，你付钱请司机载你去某个地方。出租车通常装有计价器，显示你需要支付的金额。
example_zh: 我们坐出租车去了机场。

definition: the dried leaves (called tea leaves) of the tea bush
example: a packet of tea
definition_zh: 茶树的干叶（称为茶叶）

definition: to give lessons to students in a school, college, university, etc.; to help somebody learn something by giving information about it
example: She teaches at our local school.
definition_zh: 在学校、学院、大学等机构为学生授课；通过提供相关信息来帮助某人学习某项知识
example_zh: 她在我们当地的学校教书。

definition: a person whose job is teaching, especially in a school
example: an English/a science teacher
definition_zh: 以教学为职业的人，尤其是在学校任教的人

definition: a group of people who play a particular game or sport against another group of people
example: a football/basketball/soccer team
definition_zh: 一群与另一群人进行某项特定游戏或体育运动的人
example_zh: 一支橄榄球/篮球/足球队

definition: a person who is between 13 and 19 years old
example: a magazine aimed at teenagers
definition_zh: 年龄在13岁至19岁之间的人
example_zh: 一本面向青少年的杂志

definition: a system for talking to somebody else over long distances, using wires or radio; a machine used for this
example: The telephone rang and Pat answered it.
definition_zh: 一种利用电线或无线电与远方的人通话的系统；用于此目的的设备
example_zh: 电话响了，帕特接起了电话。

definition: to speak to somebody by phone
example: Please write or telephone for details.
definition_zh: 通过电话与某人交谈
example_zh: 如需了解详情，请来信或致电。

definition: a piece of electrical equipment with a screen on which you can watch programmes with moving pictures and sounds
example: a widescreen/flat-screen/plasma television
definition_zh: 一种带有屏幕的电子设备，可以在其屏幕上观看带有动态图像和声音的节目

definition: to give information to somebody by speaking or writing
example: tell something to somebody, He told the news to everybody he saw.
definition_zh: 通过口头或书面形式向某人提供信息
example_zh: 向某人说某事，他把这个消息告诉了所有他遇到的人。

example: There are only ten of these rare animals left.
example_zh: 这种珍稀动物目前仅存十只。

definition: a game in which two or four players use rackets to hit a ball backwards and forwards across a net on a specially marked court
example: to play tennis
definition_zh: 一种由两名或四名选手在专门划定的场地内，用球拍将球越过球网来回击打的游戏

definition: very unpleasant; making you feel very unhappy, upset or frightened
example: a terrible experience
definition_zh: 非常令人不快；会让你感到非常不高兴、难过或害怕

definition: an examination of somebody’s knowledge or ability, consisting of questions for them to answer or activities for them to perform
example: an IQ/a fitness test
definition_zh: 对某人知识或能力的考核，包括要求其回答的问题或完成的任务

definition: to find out how much somebody knows, or what they can do by asking them questions or giving them activities to perform
example: test somebody, Students will be tested at the end of each module.
definition_zh: 通过向某人提问或安排其完成某些任务，来了解其掌握的知识程度或能力
example_zh: 对某人进行测试，每个模块结束时都会对学生进行测试。

definition: any form of written material
example: a computer that can process text
definition_zh: 任何形式的书面材料
example_zh: 一台能够处理文本的计算机

definition: used to introduce the second part of a comparison
example: I'm older than her.
definition_zh: 用于引出比较的第二部分

definition: used to introduce the second part of a comparison
example: I'm older than her.
definition_zh: 用于引出比较的第二部分

definition: to tell somebody that you are grateful for something
example: thank somebody for something, I must write and thank Mary for the present.
definition_zh: 向某人表达对某事的感激之情
example_zh: 为了某事感谢某人，我必须写信感谢玛丽送的礼物。

definition: used to show that you are grateful to somebody for something they have done
example: ‘How are you?’ ‘Fine, thanks (= thanks for asking).’
definition_zh: 用于表达对某人所做之事的感激之情
example_zh: “你好吗？”“挺好的，谢谢（=谢谢你的关心）。”

definition: words or actions that show that you are grateful to somebody for something
example: thanks to somebody for something, How can I ever express my thanks to you for all you've done?
definition_zh: 表达对某人某事心怀感激的话语或行为
example_zh: 感谢某人做的事，我该如何向你表达对你所做的一切的感激之情呢？

definition: used after some verbs, adjectives and nouns to introduce a new part of the sentence
example: She said (that) the story was true.
definition_zh: 用于某些动词、形容词和名词之后，以引出句子的新部分

definition: used for referring to a person or thing that is not near the speaker or as near to the speaker as another
example: Look at that man over there.
definition_zh: 用于指代不在说话者附近，或不如另一个人或事物靠近说话者的人或物

definition: used for referring to a person or thing that is not near the speaker, or not as near to the speaker as another
example: Who's that?
definition_zh: 用于指代距离说话者较远，或比其他事物距离说话者更远的人或物

definition: used to refer to somebody/something that has already been mentioned or is easily understood
example: There were three questions. The first two were relatively easy but the third one was hard.
definition_zh: 用于指代已经提过或不言自明的人或事
example_zh: 共有三个问题。前两个比较简单，但第三个很难。

definition: a building or an outdoor area where plays and similar types of entertainment are performed
example: Broadway theatres
definition_zh: 用于上演戏剧及类似娱乐节目的建筑物或露天场所

definition: of or belonging to people, animals or things that have already been mentioned or are easily identified
example: Their parties are always fun.
definition_zh: 指已提及或易于辨识的人、动物或事物，或与之相关的
example_zh: 他们的聚会总是很有趣。

definition: used when referring to people, animals or things as the object of a verb or preposition, or after the verb be
example: Tell them the news.
definition_zh: 用于指代作为动词或介词宾语的人、动物或事物，或置于动词“be”之后

definition: used to refer to a particular time in the past or future
example: Life was harder then because neither of us had a job.
definition_zh: 用于指代过去或未来某个特定的时间点
example_zh: 那时生活更艰难，因为我们俩都没工作。

definition: used to show that something exists or happens
example: There's a restaurant around the corner.
definition_zh: 用于表明某事物存在或某事发生

definition: people, animals or things that have already been mentioned or are easily identified
example: ‘Where are John and Liz?’ ‘They went for a walk.’
definition_zh: 已经提过或很容易辨认的人、动物或事物
example_zh: “约翰和莉兹在哪里？”“他们出去散步了。”

definition: an object whose name you do not use because you do not need to or want to, or because you do not know it
example: Can you pass me that thing over there?
definition_zh: 一个对象，你之所以不使用它的名称，是因为你既不需要也不想使用，或者是因为你不知道它的名称
example_zh: 你能把那边那个东西递给我吗？

definition: to have a particular idea or opinion about something/somebody; to believe something
example: think (that)…, Do you really think (that) he'll win?
definition_zh: 对某事或某人持有某种想法或看法；相信某事
example_zh: 认为（……），你真的认为他会赢吗？

definition: 3rd
example: Today is the third (of May).
definition_zh: 第3名

definition: needing or wanting to drink
example: We were hungry and thirsty.
definition_zh: 需要或想喝酒

definition: the number 13
example: There are thirteen players on the team.
definition_zh: 数字13
example_zh: 这支球队共有十三名球员。

definition: the number 30
example: She is thirty years old.
definition_zh: 数字30

definition: used to refer to a particular person, thing or event that is close to you, especially compared with another
example: How long have you been living in this country?
definition_zh: 用于指代与你关系密切的特定人物、事物或事件，尤其是与其他对象相比时
example_zh: 你在这个国家生活了多久？

definition: used to refer to a person or thing that is near you or has just been mentioned
example: This is my favourite book.
definition_zh: 用于指代离你很近或刚刚被提到的人或事物

example: There were thousands of people there.
There are only three cookies left.

definition: from one end or side of something to the other
example: Put the coffee in the filter and let the water run through.
definition_zh: 从某物的这一端或这一侧到另一端
example_zh: 将咖啡粉放入滤纸中，然后让水流过。

definition: from one end or side of something/somebody to the other
example: The burglar got in through the window.
definition_zh: 从某物或某人的这一端或这一侧到另一端或另一侧
example_zh: 小偷是从窗户钻进来的。

definition: the day of the week after Wednesday and before Friday
example: It's Thursday today, isn't it?
definition_zh: 周三之后、周五之前的那个星期几

definition: a printed piece of paper, or a message or image received on your phone or computer, that gives you the right to travel on a particular bus, train, etc. or to go into a theatre, etc.
example: a plane/bus/train ticket
definition_zh: 一张打印出来的纸，或者通过手机或电脑收到的信息或图片，它赋予你乘坐特定公交车、火车等交通工具，或进入剧院等场所的权利。

definition: what is measured in minutes, hours, days, etc.
example: The world exists in time and space.
definition_zh: 以分钟、小时、天等为单位进行计量的东西。

definition: feeling that you would like to sleep or rest; needing rest
example: to be/look/feel tired
definition_zh: 想睡觉或休息的感觉；需要休息

definition: the name of a book, poem, painting, piece of music, etc.
example: What's title of her new book?
definition_zh: 书籍、诗歌、绘画、乐曲等的名称。

definition: used to show purpose or intention
example: I set out to buy food.
definition_zh: 用于表示目的或意图

definition: in the direction of something; towards something
example: I walked to the office.
definition_zh: 朝某物方向；朝某物而去

definition: on this day
example: I've got a piano lesson later today.
definition_zh: 这一天
example_zh: 今天晚些时候我有一节钢琴课。

definition: this day
example: Today is her tenth birthday.
definition_zh: 这一天

definition: with or near to somebody/something else; with each other
example: We grew up together.
definition_zh: 与某人/某物在一起或靠近某人/某物；彼此在一起

definition: a large bowl attached to a pipe that you sit on or stand over when you get rid of waste matter from your body
example: Have you flushed the toilet?
definition_zh: 一个连接在管道上的大碗，当你排出体内废物时，可以坐在上面或站在上面

definition: a soft fruit with a lot of juice and shiny red skin that is eaten as a vegetable either raw or cooked
example: a bacon, lettuce, and tomato sandwich
definition_zh: 一种多汁、果皮呈亮红色、质地柔软的水果，可作为蔬菜生吃或熟食
example_zh: 一份培根、生菜和番茄三明治

definition: on or during the day after today
example: I'm off now. See you tomorrow.
definition_zh: 在今天当天或次日

definition: the day after today
example: Today is Tuesday, so tomorrow is Wednesday.
definition_zh: 明天之后
example_zh: 今天是星期二，所以明天是星期三。

definition: on or during the evening or night of today
example: Will you have dinner with me tonight?
definition_zh: 在今天傍晚或晚上，或在此期间
example_zh: 今晚你能和我一起吃晚饭吗？

definition: the evening or night of today
example: Here are tonight's football results.
definition_zh: 今天傍晚或晚上
example_zh: 以下是今晚的足球比赛结果。

definition: used before adjectives and adverbs to say that something is more than is good, necessary, possible, etc.
example: He's far too young to go on his own.
definition_zh: 用于形容词和副词之前，表示某事超出了“良好”、“必要”、“可能”等程度。
example_zh: 他还太小，不能独自出门。

definition: any of the hard white structures in the mouth used for biting food
example: I've just had a tooth out at the dentist's.
definition_zh: 口腔内用于咀嚼食物的任何坚硬白色结构
example_zh: 我刚在牙医那里拔了一颗牙。

definition: a subject that you talk, write or learn about

definition: the day before today
example: Yesterday was Sunday.
definition_zh: 前天

definition: used as the subject or object of a verb or after a preposition to refer to the person or people being spoken or written to
example: You said you knew the way.
definition_zh: 用作动词的主语或宾语，或置于介词之后，指被谈论或被写信的对象

definition: having lived or existed for only a short time; not fully developed
example: Young babies need to be wrapped up warmly.
definition_zh: 仅存活或存在了一段时间；尚未完全发育成熟

definition: of or belonging to the person or people being spoken or written to
example: I like your dress.
definition_zh: 指被谈论或被写信对象的，或属于该对象或这些对象的

definition: used when the person or people being spoken to both cause and are affected by an action
example: Have you hurt yourself?
definition_zh: 用于指代被谈论的人既引发了某项行动，又受到该行动的影响
